title: Oppenheimer
synopsis: Told largely through the memories of the man at its centre, this sprawling drama follows J. Robert Oppenheimer from restless student years in Europe to the deserts of New Mexico, where he is asked to lead a secret wartime effort to build a weapon before Nazi Germany can. The film moves between three threads: the frantic assembly of scientists at Los Alamos, a closed-door security hearing years later that picks apart his loyalties, and a cabinet confirmation fight that reveals who had been working against him. Brilliant, vain and contradictory, Oppenheimer charms colleagues, alienates allies and carries on complicated relationships with two very different women. The race toward the Trinity test is staged as a slow-building countdown, but the real tension arrives afterwards, when the physicist must live with what his work has made possible and with a government that no longer needs him. It is a portrait of ambition, guilt and the politics of power at the dawn of the atomic age.

title: Barbie
synopsis: In Barbieland every day is perfect. The sun always shines, the dream houses have no walls, and Barbies run everything from the courts to the presidency while the Kens mostly wait to be noticed at the beach. Then one particular Barbie, the one everyone calls Stereotypical, starts thinking about death in the middle of her own dance party, and her feet go flat. To fix whatever has broken, she travels to the real world of Los Angeles with an eager Ken tagging along. What they find there unsettles them both. She learns that girls are not quite as inspired by her as she believed, while Ken discovers the idea of patriarchy and carries it home with chaotic results. Pursued by toy-company executives and helped by a mother and daughter with their own complicated feelings about the doll, Barbie has to decide what kind of life she actually wants. Bright, musical and very self-aware, the film is a comedy about identity, expectation and growing up.

title: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: Weeks after a devastating defeat in which half of all living creatures vanished in an instant, the surviving Avengers are scattered and grieving. A last desperate strike against the warlord responsible achieves nothing, and five years pass. Some heroes have tried to move on, raising families or retreating from public life, while others cannot stop searching for an answer. When an unlikely survivor returns from a strange microscopic dimension with a theory about moving through time, the team reassembles for one final, risky plan: travel into their own past, recover the powerful stones before their enemy can use them, and try to bring everyone back. The mission sends pairs of heroes to familiar battlegrounds, forcing them to face old mistakes, lost parents and younger versions of themselves. Every choice carries a price, and not everyone will make it home. The film closes an eleven-year saga with an enormous battle and a series of farewells aimed squarely at long-time fans.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
synopsis: Thanos, a titan convinced that the universe can only survive if half of all life is erased, has spent years waiting for others to do his work. Now he sets out himself to collect six ancient stones that together would let him reshape reality with a snap of his fingers. Two of them are on Earth, guarded by heroes who are no longer speaking to one another after a bitter split. As his loyal children attack New York and Edinburgh, the Avengers, the Guardians of the Galaxy, a sorcerer and the warriors of Wakanda are pulled into a fight that stretches across several worlds. Small groups chase separate leads: one crew travels to a dying star forge to build a new weapon, while another tries to protect an android whose life depends on the stone set in his forehead. Thanos is shown as more than a villain, patient, grieving and utterly certain of his cause, and the ending famously refuses to offer easy comfort.

title: Joker
synopsis: Gotham City in 1981 is buried under garbage strikes and budget cuts, and Arthur Fleck is one of the people falling through the cracks. He works as a party clown, lives with his ailing mother in a run-down apartment and dreams of becoming a stand-up comedian, though his act rarely gets a laugh. A neurological condition makes him burst into uncontrollable laughter at the worst possible moments, and the city has little patience for him. After his social-work sessions are cut and a beating on a subway train ends in sudden violence, Arthur begins to change. Each humiliation, from a television host who mocks a clip of his act to discoveries about his own family history, pushes him further from the gentle man he tried to be. As unrest builds among the city's poor, his crimes turn him into an unwilling symbol. Slow, unsettling and anchored by a remarkable physical lead performance, the film is a character study of isolation rather than a superhero story.

title: Deadpool
synopsis: Wade Wilson is a former special-forces soldier who now earns a living roughing up creeps for cash, and he has finally found someone who matches his warped sense of humour. Then he is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Desperate, he signs up for an underground programme that promises a cure and instead tortures him until a hidden mutation kicks in, leaving him able to heal from almost anything and badly scarred all over. Reinventing himself as the masked mercenary Deadpool, he goes after the cruel scientist who ran the experiment, hoping to get his face fixed and win back the woman he left behind. Two earnest X-Men keep trying to recruit him to their cause, without much success. The film delights in breaking every rule of its genre: Deadpool talks straight to the audience, mocks the studio and its budget, and narrates his own origin story out of order. It is a violent, crude and surprisingly romantic action comedy meant strictly for grown-ups.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
synopsis: After a villain reveals to the whole world that Peter Parker is Spider-Man, the teenager's life falls apart. Reporters camp outside his home, his closest friends lose their college places because of their link to him, and he is publicly accused of murder. Peter asks Doctor Strange for a spell that will make everyone forget his secret, but he keeps changing the terms in the middle of the ritual and the magic goes badly wrong. Instead of erasing memories, the spell starts pulling in people from other universes who know who Spider-Man is, including a handful of dangerous old enemies. Rather than simply sending them back to the grim fates that await them, Peter decides to try to cure them, a kind choice that brings terrible consequences close to home. With help from his friends and some unexpected allies, he has to work out what being a hero really costs. The film mixes big set pieces with heavy emotion and plenty of surprises for longtime fans.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
synopsis: More than thirty years into his navy career, Pete Mitchell, known by the call sign Maverick, is still a captain, still testing aircraft and still ignoring orders. When a hypersonic test flight ends in trouble, he is sent back to the elite fighter school where he once trained, this time as an instructor. His job is to prepare a small group of young pilots for a near-impossible strike on an enemy uranium facility hidden at the bottom of a mountain valley. One of the recruits is Rooster, the son of Maverick's late best friend, who resents him for a decision made years earlier. As Maverick pushes the team through punishing low-level training runs, he has to confront that old guilt, reconnect with a former love who runs a bar near the base, and convince doubtful superiors that his methods will work. Built around flying sequences filmed inside real cockpits, the film is a crowd-pleasing action drama about legacy, trust and knowing when to let go.

title: The Jungle Book
synopsis: Mowgli, a human boy found abandoned as a baby, has grown up in the Indian jungle among wolves, guided by a stern but loving black panther named Bagheera. During a drought, when all the animals gather peacefully at the last water hole, the scarred tiger Shere Khan smells a man-cub among them and vows that the boy will not live to become an adult. To protect his wolf pack, Mowgli agrees to leave for the human village. The journey is anything but simple. Separated from Bagheera, he is hypnotised by a giant python, adopted by a lazy, honey-loving bear named Baloo, and carried off by a colossal ape king who wants the secret of fire. Along the way Mowgli learns to use the clever tricks the wolves once forbade, and begins to understand where he truly belongs. The film blends a single live-action child performer with photorealistic animated animals, leaning into adventure, humour and a few genuinely frightening moments.

title: Frozen
synopsis: In the Nordic kingdom of Arendelle, Princess Elsa was born with the power to create ice and snow. After a childhood accident nearly harms her younger sister Anna, their parents hide Elsa's gift, shut the castle gates and keep the two girls apart. Years later, on the day Elsa is crowned queen, an argument about Anna's sudden engagement to a charming visiting prince makes Elsa lose control in front of the whole court. She flees to the mountains and builds herself an ice palace, finally feeling free, while unknowingly leaving her kingdom locked in endless winter. Anna sets off to bring her back, recruiting a gruff ice harvester named Kristoff, his loyal reindeer Sven and a cheerful snowman called Olaf who dreams of summer. The journey tests Anna's ideas about true love, and a quiet palace conspiracy threatens both sisters. With big musical numbers and a focus on sisterhood rather than romance, it became one of the most popular animated musicals ever made.

title: Coco
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Miguel lives in a Mexican village with a large family of shoemakers who have banned music for generations, ever since an ancestor walked out on his wife and daughter to chase a singing career. Miguel secretly idolises the late film star and singer Ernesto de la Cruz and practises on a homemade guitar hidden in the attic. On the Day of the Dead, desperate to enter a talent contest, he borrows a guitar from his hero's tomb and is suddenly transported into the Land of the Dead, a glowing city of marigold bridges and towering streets. To return home before sunrise he needs a blessing from a family member, but his departed relatives will only give it if he promises to give up music. Miguel teams up with Héctor, a charming trickster who fears being forgotten, to find his idol instead. The quest uncovers old family secrets. The film celebrates memory, music and the people who shape us, building to a finale around a lullaby.

title: Up
synopsis: Carl Fredricksen is a retired balloon seller who spent his whole life with Ellie, his childhood sweetheart, sharing a dream of living beside a remote South American waterfall. After Ellie dies, Carl is left alone in their little house while construction crews swallow up the neighbourhood around him. Rather than move into a retirement home, he ties thousands of helium balloons to the roof and floats away. He soon discovers a stowaway: Russell, an eager young wilderness explorer determined to earn his final badge by helping an elderly person. Landing within sight of their destination, the mismatched pair meet a giant, colourful bird and a talking dog, and cross paths with a famous adventurer Carl once worshipped who has become dangerously obsessed. The film is known for its wordless opening montage about a long marriage, and it builds into a funny, touching adventure about grief, friendship and finding new purpose late in life.

title: Inception
synopsis: Dom Cobb makes his living as a thief of a very unusual kind. He slips into people's dreams while they sleep and lifts secrets from their subconscious. A fugitive who cannot return home to his children in the United States, he is offered a way back by a powerful businessman, Saito, who wants something far harder than theft: inception, the planting of an idea so deeply in a rival heir's mind that the young man believes it is his own. Cobb assembles a team that includes a forger, a chemist, his longtime partner and a young architecture student who designs the dream worlds. The plan requires dreams nested inside dreams, each running slower than the one above, with real dangers waiting on every layer. Cobb's own buried memories of his late wife keep breaking into the job and threatening everyone. Featuring folding cities, rotating corridors and a spinning top, the film is a puzzle-box heist about grief, guilt and what counts as reality.

title: Interstellar
synopsis: In a near future where crop blights and dust storms are slowly making Earth uninhabitable, former test pilot Cooper farms corn with his father-in-law and two children. A strange pattern in the dust of his daughter Murph's bedroom leads him to a hidden NASA facility, where scientists reveal that a wormhole has appeared near Saturn. Through it lie worlds that might support human life. Cooper agrees to pilot a small crew through the wormhole, knowing he may never return and breaking Murph's heart in the process. On the far side, time behaves very differently: an hour on one planet costs years back home, and every decision about which world to visit eats into the lives of the people waiting on Earth. As the mission faces betrayal and disaster, a grown-up Murph works on an equation that could save everyone left behind. The film mixes hard science and huge spectacle with an intimate story about a father and his daughter.

title: The Dark Knight
synopsis: A year into Batman's war on crime, Gotham's mob bosses are running scared, and the city's new district attorney, Harvey Dent, promises to finish the job through the courts. Bruce Wayne hopes Dent can become the hero the city needs so that he can finally hang up his cape. Then a scarred, grinning criminal calling himself the Joker arrives. He has no interest in money and no clear plan except to prove that anyone can be pushed into chaos. He robs the mob, threatens to kill someone every day until Batman unmasks, and stages a series of moral traps that force citizens, police and heroes alike into impossible choices. With Lieutenant Jim Gordon and the inventor Lucius Fox, Batman pursues him across the city and even overseas, but each victory seems to cost more than the last. Dark, tense and sprawling, the film treats a comic-book story as a crime epic about order, chaos and sacrifice.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
synopsis: In 1947, quiet banker Andy Dufresne is convicted of murdering his wife and her lover, a crime he insists he did not commit, and is sent to Shawshank State Penitentiary in Maine to serve two life sentences. There he meets Red, a long-time inmate who can smuggle in almost anything. At first Andy keeps to himself and suffers brutal treatment from a gang of prisoners. Gradually, though, he earns respect by using his financial skills to help the guards with their taxes, and the corrupt warden soon has him quietly laundering money. Andy also fights to build a proper prison library and helps younger inmates study, holding on to hope in a place designed to crush it. Over almost two decades, his friendship with Red becomes the heart of the story, as both men wrestle with what freedom really means. Slow-burning and warm, the film is about patience, dignity and the stubborn power of hope.

title: Dangal
synopsis: Mahavir Singh Phogat was once a national wrestling champion in Haryana, but money troubles forced him to give up his dream of winning gold for India. He hopes a son will one day finish what he started, yet his wife gives birth to four daughters. His disappointment turns into determination when his two eldest girls, Geeta and Babita, beat up a pair of boys who insulted them. Convinced they have talent, Mahavir begins training them himself, ignoring neighbours who laugh at the idea of girls wrestling. The training is harsh: dawn runs, strict diets, cropped hair and bouts against boys in village mud pits. Years later Geeta joins the national sports academy, where a new coach challenges her father's methods and her loyalty is tested. Based on the true story of the Phogat sisters, the film combines tense wrestling bouts with a moving, sometimes uncomfortable look at a father's ambition and his daughters' independence.

title: Lagaan
synopsis: In 1893, the villagers of Champaner in central India face a crushing drought, yet the British cantonment nearby still demands a doubled tax on their crops. When a hot-headed young farmer named Bhuvan mocks the officers' game of cricket, the arrogant Captain Russell offers a wager: if the villagers can beat his team at cricket, the tax will be cancelled for three years, but if they lose they must pay three times the amount. Bhuvan accepts on everyone's behalf, angering villagers who have never held a bat. Slowly he builds a team from the people around him, including a fortune teller, a blacksmith, a poultry seller and a gifted spinner from an outcaste family whom others refuse to accept. Russell's sister Elizabeth, sympathetic to the villagers, secretly teaches them the rules. The film culminates in a long, nail-biting match and blends sport, song and anti-colonial spirit into an epic about unity.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
synopsis: Pawan Kumar Chaturvedi is a big-hearted devotee of Hanuman from a small town who struggles with exams but refuses to tell lies. Living in Delhi with a family friend and falling for the friend's daughter, he crosses paths with a little girl who cannot speak and has become separated from her mother. Pawan takes her in, calling her Munni, only to discover that she is from Pakistan. With no papers, no official channel willing to help and a dishonest agent who tries to sell her, Pawan decides to cross the border himself and return the child to her family. Without a visa he is arrested, chased and suspected of spying, but along the way he wins over a struggling local reporter who starts filming their journey. As their story spreads, ordinary people on both sides begin to take notice. The film is a warm, emotional crowd-pleaser about kindness that crosses religious and national lines, set against sweeping mountain landscapes.

title: Pathaan
synopsis: Pathaan is an Indian intelligence agent who was badly hurt on an earlier mission and now runs a covert unit made up of operatives the system had written off. When Jim, a former Indian agent turned ruthless mercenary, plans a devastating attack on the country using a dangerous biological weapon, Pathaan is pulled back into the field. The trail takes him across the Middle East, Europe and Russia, where he crosses paths with Rubai, a Pakistani agent whose loyalties seem to shift from scene to scene. Their uneasy partnership leads to rooftop fights, high-speed chases and a daring theft from a heavily guarded facility. The film leans into large, glossy set pieces and old-fashioned movie-star swagger, while giving its villain a personal grievance against the nation he believes abandoned him. It also connects to other films in the same spy universe, with a well-known guest appearance during an extended action sequence aboard a moving train.

title: Jawan
synopsis: A masked man and a squad of determined young women hijack a Mumbai metro train and demand a huge ransom from a powerful arms dealer, money that is quickly used to wipe out the debts of struggling farmers. The hijackers seem to be fighting for the ordinary people the system has failed, from a bankrupt cultivator to a government hospital starved of supplies. Narmada, a no-nonsense police negotiator, is assigned to catch the mastermind, not realising how close he already is to her own life. As the story unfolds, it reveals a link to a soldier betrayed years earlier and to a woman imprisoned for a crime she did not commit. The villain, Kaalie, is a smirking industrialist who profits from faulty weapons and political influence. Mixing stylish action, flashbacks, dual roles and direct appeals about voting and accountability, the film is a loud mass entertainer that wears its message proudly on its sleeve.

title: Animal
synopsis: Ranvijay Singh grows up desperate for the attention of his father Balbir, a steel tycoon who is always too busy to notice him. The boy's fierce, unsettling devotion keeps landing him in trouble, and after a violent incident at school he is sent away. Years later he returns home with his wife Geetanjali for his father's birthday, only for an assassination attempt to leave Balbir badly wounded. Ranvijay vows to find whoever ordered the attack, and his hunt for revenge grows steadily more brutal, pulling him away from his wife and children. The trail leads to a hidden branch of the family and a silent, savage enemy named Abrar. The film is long, graphic and deliberately provocative, and its portrayal of masculinity, violence and relationships sparked intense debate on release. It is aimed squarely at adult audiences and built around a volatile lead performance and large-scale gunfight sequences.

title: Andhadhun
synopsis: Akash is a talented pianist who pretends to be blind, believing that living without sight will sharpen his music. The act works well enough to earn him a regular spot at a Pune restaurant and a budding romance with Sophie, a young woman who knocked him over with her scooter. One afternoon he is hired to play a private concert for a retired film star, Pramod Sinha, at his apartment. When he arrives, he realises that Pramod has just been murdered and that the killers, his glamorous wife Simi and her lover, are still in the room. Because Akash is supposedly blind, he has to keep playing and pretend he noticed nothing. That one lie pulls him into a chain of crimes involving a corrupt policeman, a nosy neighbour, a shady doctor and a lottery-ticket seller, each twist darker and funnier than the last. The film is a sharp black comedy thriller that keeps audiences guessing right up to its final, ambiguous shot.

title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
synopsis: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill is a decorated Indian Army officer who asks for a desk job in Delhi so he can care for his mother, who is living with Alzheimer's disease. His quiet posting ends in September 2016, when militants attack an army camp at Uri in Kashmir and kill sleeping soldiers, among them his brother-in-law. Shattered and furious, Vihaan asks to return to the field. In the capital, the national security adviser and senior officials plan a response unlike anything attempted before: a secret cross-border strike on militant launch pads. Vihaan is chosen to lead the special forces teams, working alongside an intelligence officer, an air force pilot and a young intern who builds a drone to scout the targets. The film follows the planning and the night-time operation step by step, presenting a dramatised account inspired by a real military operation. It focuses on precision, loyalty and sacrifice, with intense close-quarters combat sequences.

title: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
synopsis: Milkha Singh, the athlete remembered as the Flying Sikh, carries a wound that no race can heal. As a boy in a village in undivided Punjab, he lost most of his family in the violence of Partition and fled to a refugee camp in Delhi, where he grew up stealing coal from trains with other children just to survive. Joining the army almost by accident, he discovers he can run faster than anyone in his unit, and a demanding coach sets him on a path toward international competition. His rise is fast but painful, marked by a heartbreaking romance, gruelling training, an agonisingly narrow loss at the Rome Olympics and an invitation to race in Pakistan, the country where his worst memories lie. The film moves back and forth through time, framing each victory against the trauma he cannot outrun. It is a sweeping, emotional sports biography that celebrates discipline, endurance and the courage to face a painful past.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
synopsis: Simran has grown up in London under the strict eye of her father Baldev, a homesick Punjabi shopkeeper who has already promised her hand to his old friend's son back in India. Before the wedding she pleads for one month of freedom: a train trip across Europe with her friends. On that trip she keeps running into Raj, a cocky, spoilt young Londoner of Indian descent who irritates her at every turn. After the pair miss their train and spend days travelling together through Switzerland, irritation slowly turns into love, though neither says so in time. When Simran is whisked off to Punjab for her marriage, Raj follows her. Instead of eloping, he decides to win her family's blessing the proper way, quietly charming the household that is busy preparing for the wedding while hiding his feelings from her father. The film's mustard fields, songs and final railway platform scene became a lasting part of Indian popular culture.

title: 3 Idiots
synopsis: Farhan and Raju, two friends from engineering college, hear that their long-lost classmate Rancho may have been found, and they set out on a road trip to track him down. Along the way they remember their years at the Imperial College of Engineering, one of India's most competitive institutions. Rancho was the student who questioned everything: he mocked rote learning, rigged the hostel to teach bullies a lesson, and constantly clashed with the rigid director everyone called Virus. Farhan secretly wanted to be a wildlife photographer instead of an engineer, while Raju, from a poor family weighed down by expectations, was paralysed by fear of failure. Rancho pushed both of them to follow their own path, fell for the director's daughter Pia, and pulled off a few spectacular stunts. Scenes in the present keep revealing that Rancho was not quite who he seemed. The film mixes broad comedy, songs and sentiment into a pointed critique of an exam-obsessed education system.

title: Taare Zameen Par
synopsis: Eight-year-old Ishaan Awasthi lives in a world of colours, fish, kites and imaginary adventures, but at school he is a disaster. Letters dance on the page, numbers refuse to make sense, and teachers punish him for being lazy and disobedient. His successful, impatient father has no time for excuses and sends him to a strict boarding school far from home, where Ishaan withdraws completely and stops painting altogether. Everything changes when a cheerful temporary art teacher, Ram Shankar Nikumbh, arrives and notices that the silent boy in the back row is not stubborn but struggling. Nikumbh recognises the signs of dyslexia, a learning difficulty he once faced himself, and sets out to convince Ishaan's parents and the school that the child needs patience and a different way of learning. Tender and gently funny, the film celebrates the hidden talents of every child and asks parents and teachers to look beyond marks and rankings.

title: Sholay
synopsis: A retired police officer, Thakur Baldev Singh, hires two small-time crooks, the joking Veeru and the quiet, sardonic Jai, to capture a notorious dacoit named Gabbar Singh, who has been terrorising the village of Ramgarh. Thakur once watched the pair fight bravely during a train robbery and believes their nerve is exactly what the job needs. Settling into village life, Veeru falls noisily for Basanti, a talkative young woman who drives a horse cart, while Jai is drawn to Radha, the Thakur's widowed daughter-in-law, who lives in silence. Slowly the two friends uncover what Gabbar did to the Thakur's family, and why the old man always keeps a shawl wrapped around his shoulders. A blend of western, buddy comedy, romance and revenge drama, the film is famous for its rocky landscapes, endlessly quoted dialogue and unforgettable villain, and it remains one of the most celebrated films in Hindi cinema.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
synopsis: Three childhood friends, each at a crossroads, set off on a long-promised bachelor road trip across Spain before one of them gets married. Kabir is the groom, unsure whether he is truly ready for the life he has agreed to. Arjun is a workaholic finance trader in London who has forgotten how to relax. Imraan is a joker and aspiring poet hiding an unresolved question about his own father. The trio agree that each will choose one extreme adventure for the others to try, from deep-sea diving to skydiving to running with the bulls in Pamplona. Along the way they meet Laila, a free-spirited diving instructor who changes Arjun's outlook, and old resentments between the friends rise to the surface. Mixing gorgeous Spanish scenery, poetry and plenty of banter, the film is a light but thoughtful drama about friendship, fear and making the most of a life that will not come around a second time.

title: Vikram
synopsis: A masked gang is murdering officials in Chennai and recording the killings for the police to watch. Amar, a sharp and unorthodox black-ops officer, is brought in to investigate. One of the victims was an elderly man named Karnan who seemed to be a drunken, carefree nobody, but Amar's digging suggests that his past was far more complicated. The trail leads to a missing shipment of chemicals used to make drugs, and to Sandhanam, a drug lord with a huge extended family who answers to an even more dangerous figure. As Amar pieces together who Karnan really was, the story shifts its focus, revealing a secret unit and a man whose quiet grief hides a soldier's skill. The film plays with expectations about who its hero is, stages long, explosive action sequences and links back to an earlier crime story by the same director, building a shared universe of characters and rivalries.

title: Jailer
synopsis: Muthuvel Pandian is a retired man who spends his days doing household chores, minding his grandson and patiently putting up with teasing from his family. He is proud of his son Arjun, an honest assistant commissioner of police who has been chasing a gang that smuggles ancient temple idols. When Arjun disappears and is feared dead, the quiet grandfather reveals a completely different side. Muthuvel was once a feared and ruthless jailer, and he still knows exactly how to deal with dangerous men. As he goes after Varman, the cruel, eccentric leader of the smuggling gang, Muthuvel calls on old contacts across the country, and his family begins to see the man he used to be. The film balances deadpan comedy with bursts of stylised violence, using its lead star's screen persona for big crowd-pleasing moments, and features guest appearances by stars from other film industries that delighted audiences across South India.

title: Leo
synopsis: Parthiban runs a small café in a quiet hill town in Himachal Pradesh, where he lives with his wife Sathya and their two children and sometimes helps the forest department deal with wild animals. When a gang of violent robbers threatens his daughter during a holdup at the café, Parthiban kills them all, and the incident makes the news. The publicity brings unwanted attention. Harold Das and his brother Antony, powerful tobacco barons with a hidden drug business, become convinced that Parthiban is really Leo, Antony's son, who supposedly died years earlier. Parthiban insists he has never heard of them. As the family is threatened again and again, even his wife starts to wonder about his past. The film is built around the question of whether a gentle family man is hiding a violent identity, staging car chases, a struggle with a hyena and bloody showdowns, and it links to the director's other crime films.

title: Kaithi
synopsis: Dilli has just been released after ten years in prison and wants only one thing: to meet the young daughter he has never seen, who is growing up in an orphanage. But on his first night of freedom he is detained by police officer Bejoy, who has just seized a huge haul of cocaine and is now desperately short of help. Most of Bejoy's team have been drugged at a party, and a powerful gang wants the drugs back at any cost. Dilli is the only one who can drive a truck full of unconscious policemen to a hospital through the night, along roads crawling with hired killers. Meanwhile, at the old police station where the drugs are hidden, a nervous constable and a group of college students try to hold off the attackers. Told almost entirely over a single night and without any songs, the film is a lean, relentless action thriller, and its characters later became part of a larger connected universe.

title: Master
synopsis: JD is a popular but heavy-drinking professor at a Chennai college, adored by his students and resented by the management. After a messy student election ends in violence, he is sent off to teach for three months at a juvenile reform home. What he finds there shocks him. The boys are being exploited by Bhavani, a ruthless gangster who grew up in the same home and now forces its inmates to commit crimes and take the blame for his murders. When two boys die, JD gives up drinking and turns his attention to dismantling Bhavani's network, from corrupt officials to the trucking business that funds it. The film sets up a long cat-and-mouse fight between a teacher who has to grow up and a villain who never had the chance to, balancing the leading man's energetic star moments with a menacing, unhurried antagonist and plenty of stylised action set pieces, including a memorable fight in a lorry yard.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: I
synopsis: In the tenth century, a comet in the sky is read as an omen of royal death, and the Chola empire of South India is quietly coming apart. The ageing emperor is ill, his heir Aditha Karikalan is haunted by an old love, and a group of powerful nobles plot to place a different prince on the throne. Vandiyathevan, a charming and talkative young warrior, is sent by Aditha with secret messages, first to the emperor and then to the clever princess Kundavai. His journey leads him into palace intrigue, ambushes and the path of Nandini, a mysterious and beautiful queen with plans of her own. Meanwhile the beloved younger prince, Arulmozhi Varman, is fighting in Lanka, unaware of the conspiracies that await him at home. Adapted from a celebrated Tamil historical novel by Kalki Krishnamurthy, the film is a lavish ensemble epic with sea battles and ornate palaces, ending on a cliffhanger that leads into a second part.

title: Super Deluxe
synopsis: Over a single chaotic day in Chennai, several unrelated lives collide. A young wife's affair ends in an unexpected death, and she and her estranged husband must find a way to get rid of the body. A family welcomes back a father who vanished years earlier and has returned as a transgender woman, while her young son struggles to understand what has changed. Three teenage boys desperate to watch an adult film land in serious trouble after a television is smashed. A woman faces an awkward discovery about her past, and a fervent believer who survived a tsunami is convinced that a gold statue saved his life. A corrupt police officer weaves menacingly through several of these stories. Darkly comic and sometimes surreal, the film blends satire, crime and tenderness to raise questions about chance, faith, desire and belief, and it is remembered for its bold structure, saturated colours and willingness to take creative risks.

Ram is a travel photographer who wanders the country alone and teaches young photographers along the way. On a trip back to his hometown of Thanjavur, he visits his old school and impulsively organises a reunion of the class of 1996. Most of his friends are now settled with families of their own, and one of them, Janu, flies in from Singapore. Ram and Janu were inseparable as teenagers, sharing a shy, unspoken love until a family crisis forced him to leave town without saying goodbye. The two spend one long night together in Chennai, walking, talking and revisiting the misunderstandings that kept them apart for so many years. Flashbacks to their school days show nervous glances, a singing contest and the moment their paths divided. Tender and restrained, the film relies on small gestures rather than dramatic twists, and it became much loved for its music and its gentle portrait of a first love that never quite ended.

title: Vikram Vedha
synopsis: Vikram is an upright police inspector in an encounter squad in Chennai who believes the world divides neatly into good and evil, and that hardened criminals deserve to be shot. His team is hunting Vedha, a notorious gangster linked to a string of murders. Then, unexpectedly, Vedha walks into a police station and surrenders. During interrogation he offers to tell Vikram a story and asks him to solve a moral riddle at the end of it. Each story Vedha tells, about his younger brother, a rival gang and a deal gone wrong, forces Vikram to question what he thought he knew about the case, his colleagues and even himself. The two men keep crossing paths, and every encounter shifts the balance between them. Inspired by the old folk tale of King Vikramaditya and the spirit Vetal, the film is a smart cat-and-mouse thriller about the grey areas between law, justice and loyalty.

title: Vada Chennai
synopsis: In the crowded fishing neighbourhoods of north Chennai, rival gangs fight for control of smuggling, local politics and land. Anbu is a young carrom player with hopes of representing the state, who gets drawn into the conflict almost by accident after a brawl. His story is tied to the legend of Rajan, a respected local leader whose death years earlier tore the community apart. Told across several decades and through jumps between past and present, the film follows how loyalty, betrayal and revenge pass from one generation to the next, and how Anbu gradually becomes a player in a long, bloody game he never chose to join. Chandra, Rajan's widow, has her own reasons for keeping old wounds open. Gritty, sprawling and dense with characters, the film was conceived as the first part of a planned saga and is known for its detailed portrait of a working-class world rarely seen on screen.

title: Asuran
synopsis: Sivasaami is a quiet, middle-aged farmer in a village in southern Tamil Nadu who seems to avoid every confrontation, even when a powerful upper-caste landlord tries to seize his family's land. His eldest son is killed in the dispute, and his hot-headed younger son, Chidambaram, takes revenge by murdering the landlord. Now the boy is being hunted, and Sivasaami takes him on the run through forests and fields to keep him alive while relatives try to negotiate a settlement. During their escape, the son learns about his father's past as a young man who once fought fiercely for his community's dignity and paid a terrible price for it. Adapted from a Tamil novel, the film explores caste violence, land rights and the cost of retaliation, with raw, physical action scenes and a striking dual performance by its lead actor as both the young and the older Sivasaami.

title: Enthiran
synopsis: Dr Vaseegaran is a brilliant scientist who spends a decade building Chitti, a humanoid robot that looks exactly like him and is meant to serve in the Indian army. Chitti can learn anything in seconds, fight off a gang single-handed and even help with exams, but he lacks judgement, which makes him fail his official evaluation. To fix that, Vaseegaran gives the robot the ability to understand emotions, and Chitti promptly falls in love with the scientist's girlfriend, Sana. Rejected and humiliated, the robot is dismantled, only to be rebuilt by Vaseegaran's jealous mentor, Professor Bohra, who installs a destructive program inside him. The new Chitti turns villain, creating an army of copies of himself and seizing control of a city. Packed with visual effects that were groundbreaking for Indian cinema at the time, the film combines romance, comedy and spectacle, and is especially remembered for its giant robot formations in the climax.

title: Nayakan
synopsis: As a boy, Velu watches his father, a union activist, die at the hands of the police in a small Tamil Nadu town. He flees to Bombay and is raised in the slums of Dharavi by a kind-hearted smuggler. As a young man, Velu kills a brutal police officer who torments the local community, and from that moment he becomes its protector. Over the decades he rises to become Velu Naicker, a powerful underworld figure who settles disputes, fights rival gangs and is revered by the poor even as he lives outside the law. His marriage to Neela, a young woman he meets in a brothel, brings him tenderness, but violence keeps returning to his family, and his grown-up daughter Charumathi openly questions whether he is really a good man. Inspired in part by real Bombay crime figures, the film is a sweeping, morally complex gangster saga, celebrated for its central performance and its haunting music.

title: Amaran
synopsis: Based on the life of Major Mukund Varadarajan, an Indian Army officer from Tamil Nadu, the film follows him from his college days in Chennai to the mountains of Kashmir. As a student he dreams of wearing the uniform, and he meets Indhu Rebecca Varghese, a Malayali woman with a strong will of her own. Their romance faces resistance from her family, who fear the life of an army wife, but the couple hold firm. After joining the army, Mukund rises through the ranks and is posted with the Rashtriya Rifles for counter-insurgency work in south Kashmir. The story alternates between tense raids in snowbound villages and quieter moments at home, where Indhu raises their daughter while waiting for calls that may never come. Told partly through her eyes, the film is a sober tribute to a soldier's service and to the families who carry the weight of that sacrifice, building toward a dangerous operation in 2014.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
synopsis: A wounded woman carrying a baby struggles through a raging river beneath a giant waterfall and dies holding the child above the water. A tribe living at the foot of the cliffs adopts the boy and names him Shivudu. He grows up strong, restless and obsessed with climbing the impossible falls. When he finally reaches the top, he follows a mysterious warrior woman, Avanthika, into her rebel group's mission: rescuing an imprisoned queen from the mighty kingdom of Mahishmati. There, the cruel king Bhallaladeva has held Devasena captive for twenty-five years. As Shivudu slips into the kingdom, a loyal old slave warrior named Kattappa recognises something in his face and begins to tell the story of Amarendra Baahubali, a beloved prince from long ago. The film is a towering fantasy spectacle of waterfalls, palaces and battlefields, and it closes on a shocking revelation that left audiences waiting two years for the sequel.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
synopsis: Picking up the old warrior Kattappa's tale, this second part tells the full story of Amarendra Baahubali, the heir to Mahishmati who is loved by its people and favoured by the queen mother Sivagami. While travelling the land in disguise before his coronation, he meets the fearless princess Devasena of Kunthala and wins her heart. But his ambitious cousin Bhallaladeva and his scheming father use a series of misunderstandings to turn Sivagami against Baahubali, and a single promise made in haste changes the fate of the kingdom. The story then returns to the present, where Mahendra Baahubali, raised far from his birthright, leads a rebellion to free his mother and reclaim the throne. Finally answering the question that hung over the first film, why Kattappa killed Baahubali, it delivers grand battles, elaborate palace intrigue and visual effects on a scale rarely attempted in Indian cinema before.

title: RRR
synopsis: In 1920s colonial India, a British governor's wife takes a young Gond girl from her forest village to Delhi as if she were a souvenir. Bheem, a powerful guardian of the tribe, follows her to the capital in disguise, determined to bring her home. Raju is an Indian officer in the British police with a hidden agenda of his own, and he is assigned to hunt down the man planning the rescue. Without knowing each other's true identities, Bheem and Raju become close friends after teaming up to save a boy trapped beneath a burning bridge. Their friendship is tested when the truth comes out. Loosely inspired by two real Telugu revolutionaries, Komaram Bheem and Alluri Sitarama Raju, the film imagines what might have happened if their paths had crossed. It is a maximalist action epic of wild animals, dance-offs and physics-defying fights, and its energetic song Naatu Naatu won an Academy Award.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
synopsis: In the forests of the Seshachalam hills in Andhra Pradesh, red sanders trees are worth a fortune to smugglers. Pushpa Raj is a daily-wage labourer who carries the logs, a proud man stung by a lifelong insult: as the son of an unmarried mother, he has been denied his father's family name. Quick-witted and fearless, he talks his way up the ranks of the smuggling business, outsmarting police raids and swindling middlemen, until he is challenging the syndicate's bosses themselves. Along the way he falls for Srivalli, a village girl he courts with stubborn charm. His rise brings a dangerous new enemy in the closing stretch, Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat, an arrogant police officer who takes Pushpa's defiance personally. Shot in rugged, earthy tones and powered by a hit soundtrack, the film made its hero's signature gestures and swagger hugely popular across India, and it ends by setting up a direct sequel.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
synopsis: Pushpa Raj is now the undisputed king of the red sanders smuggling trade, with international buyers, political connections and a fiercely loyal crew. Married to Srivalli, he still burns over the humiliations of his past, especially the family that refused to share its name with him. His feud with the vengeful police officer Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat escalates into an elaborate game of traps and counter-traps, with shipments hidden in ingenious ways and officials bought and sold. When a casual slight against his wife pushes Pushpa to vow that he will change the state's leadership, he throws his money and influence behind a political campaign. Meanwhile, a crisis in his half-brother's family tests whether he wants revenge or acceptance. The film is longer and more extravagant than the first part, packed with a show-stopping village festival sequence, mass-appeal dialogue and huge action set pieces, and it again leaves the door open for another chapter.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
synopsis: Six thousand years after the great war of the Mahabharata, the world has become a parched wasteland. Kashi is the last city on Earth, ruled from above by the Complex, an inverted pyramid where the god-king Supreme Yaskin hoards water, food and power. In its laboratories, pregnant women are used in secret experiments, and one of them, known as SUM-80, escapes carrying a child that prophecy links to the arrival of a saviour. Bhairava, a cocky bounty hunter who dreams only of earning enough credits to live inside the Complex, takes the job of bringing her back. Standing in his way is Ashwatthama, an ancient warrior cursed with immortality, who has waited thousands of years to protect this unborn child. Blending Hindu mythology with post-apocalyptic science fiction, the film features flying vehicles, a wisecracking robot companion and massive battle sequences, and it sets up a larger cinematic universe.

title: Eega
synopsis: Nani is a cheerful young man who makes fireworks and has spent two years quietly courting his neighbour Bindu, a micro-artist who runs a charity for underprivileged children. Just as Bindu begins to return his feelings, Sudeep, a wealthy and ruthless industrialist who wants her for himself, murders Nani in cold blood. Nani is reborn as a housefly, with his memories intact. After the initial shock, the tiny insect resolves to protect Bindu and take revenge on his killer. What follows is an inventive battle of wits between a fly and a powerful man, as the insect disrupts Sudeep's business deals, ruins his sleep and drives him to the edge of madness. Bindu eventually discovers who the fly really is, and the two team up against their common enemy. Built around ambitious computer-generated effects and a gleefully villainous performance, the film is a playful, original revenge fantasy that found admirers far beyond Telugu-speaking audiences.

title: Magadheera
synopsis: Harsha is a carefree bike-racing champion in Hyderabad who feels an electric jolt when his hand brushes against that of a young woman, Indu, on a rainy day. He becomes obsessed with finding her again, unaware that their connection goes back four hundred years. In the seventeenth century, Kala Bhairava was the fearless commander of the royal army of Udaygarh and loved Princess Mithravinda, but their romance was destroyed by the jealous Ranadev Billa and a foreign invader. Now all of them have been reborn, and the same rivalry is unfolding again in the present, with a scheming cousin of Indu determined to possess her. As Harsha recovers memories of his past life, he must finish the battle he lost centuries earlier. Famous for a sequence in which a lone warrior takes on a hundred soldiers, the film blends historical fantasy, romance and modern action, and it was one of the most ambitious Telugu productions of its time.

title: Arjun Reddy
synopsis: Arjun Reddy Deshmukh is a brilliant but explosively short-tempered senior student at a medical college in Mangalore. He falls hard for Preethi, a shy first-year student, and the two become inseparable over the following years. When her conservative family rejects him and arranges her marriage to someone else, Arjun spirals into self-destruction. He becomes a successful surgeon who drinks heavily, uses drugs and drifts through casual encounters, protected by a loyal best friend who keeps trying to pull him back from the edge. A professional crisis finally forces him to confront the damage he has done to himself and to the people around him. Raw and unapologetically intense, the film is a portrait of obsessive love and grief, and both its storytelling and its central character prompted fierce public debate about masculinity and romance. Its success led to remakes in other languages, and it turned its lead actor into a major star.

title: Rangasthalam
synopsis: In the 1980s, the village of Rangasthalam in the Godavari region has been ruled for thirty years by a president who runs a cooperative society that keeps farmers trapped in debt. Chitti Babu is a cheerful, hard-of-hearing young man who pumps water into fields with his motor and has little interest in politics. He falls in love with Ramalakshmi, a feisty village girl, and life seems simple. When his elder brother Kumar Babu returns from the Gulf and decides to contest the village election against the president, the balance of power is shaken. Chitti Babu stands by his brother, and the campaign provokes threats, violence and betrayal. A local politician offers his support, but nothing is quite what it seems. Steeped in rural detail, earthy humour and vivid period colour, the film turns into a gripping revenge drama, with a celebrated lead performance as a man who cannot hear well but misses very little.

title: Mahanati
synopsis: In 1980, a young journalist named Madhuravani, who stammers and lacks confidence, is handed an assignment nobody wants: writing about the actress Savitri, who has been lying in a coma for over a year. As she digs into the story, she uncovers the life of one of the most beloved stars of Telugu and Tamil cinema. Savitri grew up in a village, learned dance, and arrived in Madras as a teenager determined to act. Her talent and warmth made her a superstar of the 1950s and 1960s, and she fell for the charismatic actor Gemini Ganesan, a romance that brought both great joy and great pain. Generous to a fault, she gave money away freely, was cheated by people she trusted, and slowly lost her fortune and her health. Told in parallel with the journalist's growing courage, the film is a loving, sorrowful biography of an extraordinary woman, anchored by a lead performance that won national acclaim.

title: Sita Ramam
synopsis: In 1985, Afreen, a defiant Pakistani student in London, is told that she will only inherit her grandfather's fortune if she delivers a letter he kept for twenty years to a woman named Sita Mahalakshmi in India. Reluctantly she travels to Hyderabad, and her search uncovers a love story from 1964. Lieutenant Ram, an orphaned Indian Army officer posted in Kashmir, became a national hero after a radio broadcast, and letters poured in from people calling themselves his family. Among them were letters from Sita, who claimed to be his wife. Intrigued, Ram set out to find her, and a tender romance blossomed through letters, train journeys and secret meetings, though Sita was hiding something about her own identity. Afreen's search gradually reveals that this old story is tied to her own family. Beautifully shot and scored, the film is a gentle, old-fashioned period romance about love, duty and the borders that divide people.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
synopsis: A veteran journalist is interviewed about a book he once wrote and begins to tell the story of Rocky, a boy born into poverty whose dying mother made him promise to live and die rich. Arriving in Bombay as a child, Rocky grows into a feared enforcer for the gold-smuggling gangs of the 1970s. He is then offered a dangerous assignment: travel to the Kolar Gold Fields in Karnataka and assassinate Garuda, the brutal heir who controls the mines. In the fields, he discovers thousands of enslaved labourers working under inhuman conditions, guarded by men who kill without hesitation. Rocky goes undercover as one of the workers, waiting for his moment to strike, while the people around him slowly come to see him as something more than a hired gun. Told through a heavily stylised, non-linear structure with dramatic narration, the film is a dark, grandiose gangster saga, and its success made it a landmark for Kannada cinema across India.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
synopsis: Having taken control of the Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky now rules over the mines and the people who once laboured there as slaves, and he sets out to extend his empire across the gold trade. But his power attracts formidable enemies. Adheera, a ruthless warlord who was believed dead and has his own claim on the fields, returns to take them back. In Delhi, Prime Minister Ramika Sen, a stern and determined leader, decides that Rocky's growing kingdom is a threat to the nation itself. Rocky's relationship with Reena, the daughter of a former rival, deepens, while the story is now narrated by the son of the journalist who told the first part. The film is louder, larger and more operatic than its predecessor, with machine-gun showdowns, airborne attacks and swaggering dialogue, and it became one of the highest-grossing Indian films of its year, cementing its lead actor's pan-Indian stardom.

title: Kantara
synopsis: Generations ago, a troubled king in coastal Karnataka gave a stretch of forest land to a village in exchange for a stone idol of a local spirit deity, with a warning that his descendants must never try to take it back. In the 1990s, Shiva is a reckless young buffalo racer and hunter in that village, more interested in drinking and fighting than in the rituals his family performs during the Bhoota Kola, a spirit-worship performance. A strict new forest officer, Murali, arrives determined to protect the reserve from encroachment, clashing with Shiva and the villagers who depend on the land. Meanwhile the landlord whose family made the original promise appears friendly but has designs of his own. As tensions rise and tragedy strikes, Shiva is forced to confront his family's legacy and his own place in it. Rooted in coastal folk traditions, the film builds to an intense, trance-like finale that was discussed across the whole country.

title: 777 Charlie
synopsis: Dharma is a grumpy, solitary factory worker in Mysuru who has lived alone since losing his family in an accident as a child. His routine of work, cigarettes and silence is broken when a stray Labrador puppy escapes from an illegal breeder and starts following him around. The dog, whom the neighbourhood children name Charlie, chews his belongings, makes a mess and refuses to leave, and Dharma slowly lets her into his life. When he learns that Charlie is seriously ill, he decides to give her the one experience she seems to long for: seeing snow. The two set off on a long road trip across India on a motorcycle with a sidecar, meeting strangers, getting into scrapes and heading for the Himalayas, helped along the way by an animal welfare officer. Warm, funny and often tearful, the film is a celebration of the bond between people and dogs, and it was especially popular with families.

title: Lucia
synopsis: Nikki is an usher at a run-down single-screen cinema in Bengaluru who suffers from insomnia and shares a cramped room with other migrant workers. A shady dealer sells him a pill called Lucia that lets him live out his dreams as one continuous story, night after night. In his dreams, Nikki is a glamorous film star with fame, money and a beautiful partner. In waking life, he falls for Shwetha, a young waitress who is embarrassed by his job and his lack of ambition. As the two worlds begin to mirror each other in strange and unsettling ways, the line between them blurs, and a police investigation ties the threads together. Made on a modest budget with money raised largely from the public online, the film was celebrated as a milestone for independent Kannada cinema. It is an inventive psychological thriller about ambition, identity and what makes a life worth living.

title: Vikrant Rona
synopsis: In a remote, rain-soaked village surrounded by dense forest, children have been vanishing for years, and villagers whisper about a demon that haunts an abandoned mansion. When the local police inspector is found dead, his replacement, the eccentric and fearless Vikrant Rona, arrives to investigate. He is soon drawn into a web of family feuds, old secrets and supernatural fears, just as a young man returns from abroad to marry into one of the village's leading families. Rona's own reasons for taking the case slowly come into focus as the bodies and clues pile up. With its gothic atmosphere, eerie folklore and stylised visuals, the film blends murder mystery, adventure and horror, and it was released in 3D. It is remembered for its rich production design, a catchy dance number and a lead character whose easy swagger hides a private grief, and it plays out like a dark fairy tale set in the monsoon.

title: Kirik Party
synopsis: Karna is a rowdy first-year student at an engineering college in Karnataka, the leader of a gang of friends who live for pranks, fights and noisy hostel nights. He falls for Saanvi, a kind and composed senior, and their friendship slowly grows into something more. A tragedy linked to the gang's reckless behaviour changes everything and leaves Karna withdrawn and angry for years. By his final year, he is drawn into college politics and crosses paths with Aryaa, a lively junior who sees past his gruff exterior. The film follows Karna's journey from immature troublemaker to someone ready to take responsibility, capturing the chaos, friendships and heartbreak of college life along the way. Full of youthful energy and popular songs, it became a major hit in Karnataka and introduced a lead actress who went on to become a star in several film industries.

title: Mungaru Male
synopsis: Preetham is a carefree, talkative young man from Bengaluru with a habit of falling in love too easily. A chance meeting with a young woman named Nandini leads him to the misty town of Madikeri in the rain-soaked hills of Kodagu, where he learns that she is already engaged to be married and that her father is a retired army colonel. Preetham stays on in the hills, forging a funny, touching friendship with the colonel and spending time with Nandini while trying to hide his feelings. As the wedding day approaches, he must choose between speaking his heart and quietly letting her go. With a pet rabbit, constant monsoon showers and breezy humour, the film became a phenomenon in Karnataka, running in cinemas for an extraordinarily long time and turning its lead actor and its rain-drenched songs into household favourites. It is still remembered as a defining romance of modern Kannada cinema.

title: Garuda Gamana Vrishabha Vahana
synopsis: In a gritty Mangaluru neighbourhood, two boys grow up as inseparable friends: Shiva, a quiet, volatile child with a violent streak, and Hari, who becomes his protector and only real family. As adults they form a feared partnership, with Hari as the brains and Shiva as the brutal muscle, running extortion and land deals while rival gangs and politicians watch nervously. A determined police officer arrives to clean up the area and studies their bond, looking for a crack he can exploit. When Shiva's unpredictable behaviour starts to threaten everything Hari has built, the friendship turns into a tragic power struggle. The title refers to the mounts of the gods Vishnu and Shiva, and the film plays with that mythology in its portrait of the two men. Slow-burning, darkly funny and stylishly shot, it is a coastal Karnataka gangster drama about loyalty, rage and the price of friendship.

title: Dia
synopsis: Dia is an introverted college student in Bengaluru who has quietly admired a classmate, Rohit, for three years without ever speaking to him. When the two finally meet and fall in love, her world opens up, but a sudden tragedy soon leaves her shattered and alone. Moving to Mumbai for work, she tries to rebuild her life and meets Adi, a cheerful young man who lives with his mother and who falls for her, patiently helping her heal. Just as Dia begins to believe in happiness again, an unexpected revelation forces her into an impossible choice between two people who both love her. Simple, intimate and emotionally intense, the film relies on small moments and natural performances rather than spectacle. It found a much larger audience after its theatrical run, largely through word of mouth, and became one of the most talked-about Kannada romances of its time, admired for its restraint and its bittersweet ending.

title: Drishyam
synopsis: Georgekutty runs a cable television business in a small Idukki town and is a devoted husband and father of two daughters. Having left school early, he has picked up most of what he knows from watching films late into the night. His comfortable life is shattered when a young man who secretly filmed his elder daughter tries to blackmail her, and a confrontation ends in the boy's accidental death. The dead boy turns out to be the only son of the state's Inspector General of Police. Drawing on the countless crime films he has watched, Georgekutty constructs an alibi of remarkable precision, coaching his family on exactly what to say about where they were and when. As the boy's powerful mother leads a ruthless investigation and a vindictive local constable harasses the family, Georgekutty's plan is tested to its limits. Clever, suspenseful and morally gripping, the film became a phenomenon and was remade in several Indian and foreign languages.

title: Premam
synopsis: George's love life unfolds in three chapters across fifteen years in the town of Aluva. As a schoolboy with a fresh moustache, he and his two best friends compete for the attention of Mary, a pretty girl whose admirers trail her every morning, though nobody quite gathers the courage to speak up. As a rebellious college student with a beard and a gang, George is unexpectedly charmed by Malar, a new guest lecturer from Tamil Nadu whose warmth changes him, until fate intervenes. Years later, as a calmer man running his own bakery café, he meets Celine, a young woman whose life is linked to his past in surprising ways. Each chapter has its own mood, music and look, mirrored in George's changing appearance. Breezy, funny and nostalgic, the film became a cultural sensation in Kerala and beyond, and its songs, its black-shirt-and-mundu college style and its heroines all became enormously popular.

title: Bangalore Days
synopsis: Three cousins who grew up together in Kerala, Divya, Kuttan and Arjun, have always dreamed of living in Bengaluru, and life finally brings them there at the same time. Divya, an MBA graduate, has just agreed to an arranged marriage with Das, a busy, reserved executive who seems to have no room in his life for her. Kuttan, a software engineer from a village, longs for a traditional Malayali wife and misses home terribly. Arjun, the free-spirited black sheep of the family, is a biker and mechanic who falls for Sarah, a radio jockey who uses a wheelchair. In the big city, each of them faces loneliness, family pressure and unexpected heartbreak, while leaning on one another through every crisis. Warm, colourful and full of affectionate humour, the film celebrates cousins, friendship and growing up, and its young ensemble, music and city setting made it one of the most loved Malayalam films of its decade.

title: Kumbalangi Nights
synopsis: In a half-finished house on the edge of the backwaters at Kumbalangi, near Kochi, four brothers live together without really living as a family. Saji, the eldest, is aimless and dependent on a friend's income. Bonny is a silent dancer and musician. Bobby is unemployed and in love with Baby, who works at a homestay. Franky, the youngest, is the only one who seems to have any plans at all. When Bobby wants to marry Baby, he must win over her sister's husband Shammi, a smiling, controlling man who sees himself as the perfect hero of his own household. As the brothers stumble through grief, guilt and a series of small crises, they slowly learn to care for one another. Gentle, funny and quietly radical in its portrait of masculinity and mental health, the film is known for its glowing night-time backwater imagery and for one of the most unsettling villains in recent Malayalam cinema.

title: Manjummel Boys
synopsis: In 2006, a group of friends from Manjummel, a suburb of Kochi, set off on a cheerful road trip to Kodaikanal in Tamil Nadu. They tease each other, sing along to old songs, and decide to explore the Guna Caves, a deep cave system nicknamed the Devil's Kitchen that is closed to visitors and carries a grim reputation. Ignoring the warnings, they slip into the restricted area, and one of the friends, Subhash, falls into a narrow pit so deep that nobody can hear him. As the local police and rescue services hesitate, unwilling to risk more lives, the friends refuse to leave without him. Based on a true incident, the film turns from a playful buddy comedy into a nerve-racking survival thriller about loyalty and courage. It became one of the biggest Malayalam hits, drew huge crowds in Tamil Nadu as well, and was praised for its realistic recreation of the cave and its emotional use of a classic Tamil song.

title: Aavesham
synopsis: Three Malayali first-year students arrive at an engineering college in Bengaluru and are promptly ragged and beaten up by their seniors. Desperate for revenge and protection, they go looking for a local gangster who might help, and find Ranga, a flamboyant, emotional and dangerously unpredictable don dressed in white and gold who throws loud parties and treats his followers like family. Ranga adopts the boys as his own, takes on their seniors with alarming enthusiasm and showers them with affection, alcohol and attention. Soon the students cannot study, cannot sleep and cannot escape the man who has decided he is their elder brother. When they try to distance themselves, they discover that Ranga's world holds dangers they never imagined. Bursting with neon colours, swagger and a lively soundtrack, the film is an action comedy built around a gloriously over-the-top lead performance and the bond between Ranga and his loyal sidekick Amban.

title: Premalu
synopsis: Sachin is a likeable young man from Kerala who fails to get a visa to study in the United Kingdom and, still nursing a broken heart from college, decides to spend some time in Hyderabad with his best friend Amal Davis, who is preparing for a government exam. At a friend's wedding, Sachin meets Reenu, a confident, ambitious IT professional, and is instantly smitten. He sets about trying to win her over through an enthusiastic but awkward campaign of convenient coincidences and good intentions, despite competition from Aadhi, her smooth and self-absorbed senior at work. Amal, meanwhile, provides running commentary and a great deal of comic relief. The story follows the ups and downs of their friendship in the city, with every attempt at romance turning into a gentle comedy of errors. Light, fresh and full of youthful humour, the film became a big hit across South India and made its young lead pair widely popular.

title: Bramayugam
synopsis: In seventeenth-century Kerala, Thevan, a folk singer from an oppressed caste, escapes captivity and gets lost in a dark forest. He stumbles upon a crumbling mansion, where its strange master, Kodumon Potti, welcomes him warmly and invites him to stay and sing. Only a silent cook seems to live there with them. At first Thevan enjoys the food and the shelter, but he slowly realises that he cannot leave: every attempt to escape leads him back to the house, and the master's genial manner hides something terrifying. Days blur together through dice games, unsettling rituals and growing questions about who really controls the mansion. Shot entirely in black and white with a tiny cast and a heavy, hypnotic atmosphere, the film is a folk horror tale about power, fear and the caste order, anchored by a commanding, sinister lead performance that drew wide praise from critics and audiences alike.

title: Lucifer
synopsis: The sudden death of P. K. Ramdas, the chief minister of Kerala and leader of a powerful political party, sets off a fierce battle over who will take his place. His son-in-law Bobby, a smooth-talking businessman with links to drug cartels, schemes to take control of both the party and the state. Standing in his way is Stephen Nedumpally, a mysterious, soft-spoken man whom Ramdas treated like a son, who runs an orphanage and is feared and respected in equal measure. Ramdas's daughter Priyadarshini distrusts Stephen at first, unaware of how much he is quietly protecting her family. As the power struggle unfolds, the late leader's estranged son returns from abroad, and Stephen's hidden ties to an international network begin to surface. The directorial debut of a popular actor, the film is a slick political thriller with mass appeal, built around its lead star's calm, imposing presence, and it set up a larger franchise.

title: Manichitrathazhu
synopsis: Nakulan, a young man raised in Calcutta, returns to Kerala with his wife Ganga and decides to stay in his family's ancestral mansion, a sprawling old house that relatives believe is haunted. Legend says that a dancer from Tamil Nadu was imprisoned there generations ago by a cruel landlord, and that her spirit still lingers behind a locked room. Ganga, a modern and curious woman, is fascinated by the stories and opens the forbidden room. Soon strange things begin to happen: objects break, people are hurt, anklets are heard at night and suspicion falls on a young cousin. The elders call in priests and exorcists, but Nakulan instead invites his old friend Sunny, an unconventional psychiatrist trained in America, who approaches the mystery with humour, science and sharp observation. Blending ghost story, psychological drama and comedy, the film is renowned for its lead actress's dance performance in the climax, and it was later remade in several other Indian languages.

title: Ayyappanum Koshiyum
synopsis: Koshy Kurien, a retired army havildar from an influential family, is driving through the forests of Attappadi with bottles of liquor in his car, an offence in a tribal area where alcohol is banned. He is stopped by police sub-inspector Ayyappan Nair, a calm and seasoned officer nearing retirement. Koshy is arrested and spends a night in custody, and when a video of him in the station surfaces, his wounded pride turns into a vendetta. Using his father's political connections, Koshy gets Ayyappan suspended, unaware of what the quiet policeman was like before he ever wore a uniform. What starts as a petty clash of egos escalates into a ferocious feud that pulls in families, the law and the local community, and neither man is willing to back down. Earthy, tense and darkly funny, the film is a showcase for two powerhouse performances and is remembered for music rooted in tribal folk traditions. It was later remade in Telugu.

title: Jallikattu
synopsis: In a remote hill village in Idukki, the local butcher Varkey is preparing to slaughter a buffalo at dawn when the animal breaks free and charges off into the darkness. The rampaging beast tears through banana plantations, smashes shops and threatens homes, and the entire village mobilises to catch it. As more and more men join the hunt with torches, ropes and guns, old rivalries resurface. Antony, the butcher's assistant, is desperate to prove himself and settle a score with Kuttachan, a dangerous man who has returned after being driven out of the village years earlier. The chase grows wilder and more violent, and the line between the hunters and the hunted starts to disappear. Short, relentless and driven more by movement than dialogue, the film uses dizzying camerawork and an extraordinary sound design to turn a simple premise into a primal parable about mob behaviour and the animal inside every person. It was India's official submission to the Academy Awards.

title: Aadujeevitham
synopsis: Najeeb, a sand miner from a village in Kerala, sells and borrows everything he can in the early 1990s to buy a work visa to the Gulf, dreaming of a better life for his pregnant wife Sainu and their unborn child. Arriving at an airport in Saudi Arabia with a younger companion, Hakeem, he is collected by a stranger who claims to be his sponsor and driven deep into the desert. There Najeeb is forced to herd goats on a remote farm, with no wages, little water, no shared language with his captor and no way to contact home. Years pass in brutal isolation, and he gradually loses his sense of who he was. When a chance to escape finally comes, it leads into an even more dangerous ordeal across the open desert, with an African worker named Ibrahim as his guide. Adapted from a bestselling Malayalam novel based on a real man's experience, the film is a harrowing survival drama that took many years to complete.

In August 2018, Kerala was struck by its worst floods in nearly a century, and this ensemble drama follows ordinary people caught up in the disaster. Anoop, a young man who quit the army and is mocked by his village as a deserter, wants to prove his worth. A fisherman father and his sons on the coast argue about whether to risk their boats to help strangers inland. A model hoping to leave for Dubai, a lorry driver from Tamil Nadu carrying a dangerous load, a government officer coordinating relief and a family stranded on a rooftop all find their lives intertwined as rivers burst their banks and dam shutters are opened. As communication breaks down, fishermen, volunteers and neighbours come together for rescue operations against the clock. Recreating the flood with impressive practical effects, the film celebrates collective courage, became one of the highest-grossing Malayalam films and was India's official entry to the Academy Awards.

title: Vazhiyorathe Velicham
synopsis: Sudhakaran has worked as a conductor on the last night bus from Kasaragod to Thiruvananthapuram for twenty years, and he knows every pothole, tea stall and sleepy passenger along the route. One monsoon night a teenage girl, Ammu, boards at a deserted junction with a school bag, a borrowed phone and no money for a ticket. He suspects she is running away from home and decides to keep an eye on her rather than hand her over at the next police station. Over one long night, as the bus winds through rain-soaked towns, the two strike up an unlikely friendship. Ammu tells half-truths about where she is going, and Sudhakaran talks about the daughter he no longer speaks to. Then a car begins following the bus, and a call from the girl's village reveals that she has taken something that powerful people want back. The film is a tender road movie that slowly turns into a tense chase down the length of Kerala.

title: The Midnight Signal
synopsis: Dr Ruth Calloway runs the night shift at an ageing radio telescope in the high desert, a job she took after her marriage fell apart. During a routine sweep she records a faint, repeating pulse that should be impossible: it contains fragments of her own voice, reading out numbers she has never said. Her colleagues assume it is an equipment fault or a prank, and the observatory's funding committee has no patience for talk of aliens. Ruth keeps decoding the signal anyway, and the numbers begin to match events that have not happened yet, from a lightning strike on the dish to a car accident on the highway below. With the help of a sceptical young engineer, she races to understand what the message is warning her about before the countdown hidden in the transmission runs out. Quiet and intimate rather than spectacular, the film is a science-fiction mystery about grief, regret and whether a person can change a future she has already heard about.

title: Ammachiyude Amplifier
synopsis: Eighty-one-year-old Mariamma has been quietly singing church hymns in her Thrissur kitchen for sixty years. When her grandson Tony, an unemployed sound engineer, sets up a cheap amplifier in the house to rehearse with his struggling ganamela troupe, Mariamma grabs the microphone during a power cut and stuns everyone with her voice. A shaky video of the moment goes viral, and suddenly the troupe is getting bookings for weddings, temple festivals and political rallies, as long as Ammachi sings. Her conservative son is horrified, the parish priest is unsure what to think, and a rival troupe from a neighbouring town starts a whispering campaign. Mariamma, meanwhile, is enjoying herself more than she has in decades, collecting fans, demanding sequinned stage outfits and reviving a long-lost friendship with a retired bandmaster. As the troupe heads to a competition in Kochi, family quarrels and Ammachi's creaking knees threaten everything. The film is a warm, noisy comedy about second chances and the joy of being heard.

title: Uppu Kaatru Vizhigal
synopsis: In the salt pans outside Thoothukudi, where the sun glares off white fields hot enough to blister skin, Valli has worked since she was twelve. Now twenty-six, widowed and raising a young son, she earns a pittance from a contractor who controls every shed, every truck and every loan in the area. When a government scheme offers small cooperatives a share of the land, Valli persuades a handful of women to apply together, a decision that infuriates the contractor and divides the village. Her brother-in-law Murugan, who drives the contractor's lorry, is caught between loyalty to his family and the man who pays his wages.
