When the kingdom's master swordsmith is murdered and the secret method for forging its legendary steel blades is stolen, a young soldier named Rudradeva is accused of the crime. Escaping execution, he sets out to clear his name and recover the secret before it falls into the hands of an invading army gathering at the borders. Along the way he joins forces with Nagamma, the fearless leader of a band of forest archers, and uncovers a conspiracy inside the royal court itself. As the enemy approaches, Rudradeva must rally villagers, rebels and disgraced soldiers to defend the great fort. Featuring large-scale battles, richly recreated temple architecture and elaborate sword fights, the film is a sweeping historical action drama that celebrates the craftsmanship and courage of a golden era in the history of the Telugu lands.

title: Charminar Chai Prema
synopsis: Every evening, Salma runs her late father's famous tea stall in the shadow of the Charminar, serving Irani chai and Osmania biscuits to students, shopkeepers and tourists. Rahul, the newest marketing manager at a food delivery app, arrives with a proposal to list her stall on the app, and she throws him out. He keeps coming back with new ideas, each more ridiculous than the last, and she keeps throwing him out, while her loyal customers place bets on who will give in first. When a corporate café chain moves to buy out the old market, Salma and Rahul are forced to work together to save the stalls. Their partnership is complicated by family expectations, a jealous cousin and Rahul's growing guilt about his own company's role in the deal. Bursting with the sights, sounds and flavours of old Hyderabad, the film is a bright romantic comedy about tradition, change and a love brewed slowly over many cups of tea.

title: Mounam Matladithe
synopsis: Vaishnavi is a deaf graphic designer in Visakhapatnam who lives alone and communicates with the world through sign language, text messages and her sketchbook. One rainy night, looking out of her apartment window, she sees a man murdered in the building opposite and the killer looking straight back at her. The police find no body and treat her account with polite disbelief, partly because they cannot understand her. Only Karthik, a young constable who is learning sign language for his deaf nephew, agrees to listen. As the killer begins stalking her, cutting her power, sending messages and slipping into her building, Vaishnavi must use her sharp eye and her drawings to identify him before he strikes. The film uses sound cleverly, often dropping into silence to share her experience of the world. Tense and inventive, it is a psychological thriller that treats its heroine's deafness as a source of strength rather than vulnerability.

title: Gubbi Gaana
synopsis: Nine-year-old Chinmayi lives in a crowded apartment complex in Bengaluru and has never seen a house sparrow, though her grandmother tells endless stories of the noisy birds that once filled their village courtyard. When her school project on city birds earns a failing grade because she cannot find a single sparrow to photograph, Chinmayi decides to bring them back. With her grandfather's woodworking tools, a neighbour's broken cupboard and help from the complex's grumpy security guard, she starts building nesting boxes and planting native shrubs on the terrace. The apartment association objects, her parents worry about her grades and a construction company wants to cut down the last trees on the street. Slowly, her stubborn efforts draw in neighbours of every age. Gentle, funny and lovely to look at, the film is a children's drama about ecology, persistence and the small actions that can make a city kinder to every creature living in it.

title: Hampi Hunters
synopsis: When archaeology student Sanjay finds a coded inscription in his late grandfather's notebook, he becomes convinced that it points to a hidden chamber among the ruins of Hampi, once the capital of the Vijayanagara empire. Teaming up with his fiery cousin Kavya, a rock climber, and a talkative auto-driver guide, he sets off across the boulder-strewn landscape, decoding clues hidden in temple carvings, stepwells and royal enclosures. They are not alone. A gang that smuggles stolen antiquities abroad is also on the trail, led by a charming art dealer who seems to know more about the grandfather than he admits. As the chase moves from bazaars to riverside caves and the rapids of the Tungabhadra, the trio must stay ahead of their rivals while protecting the heritage site from looters. Fun and fast-moving, the film is a family-friendly treasure-hunt adventure that makes the most of Hampi's spectacular ruins and the history behind them.

title: Belagaavi Boxer
synopsis: Raghu is a twenty-four-year-old construction worker in Belagavi who spends his evenings in a crumbling local boxing club once run by a former national champion, Fakirappa, now a bitter man selling tea at the bus stand. Raghu has natural power but no discipline, and he fights in illegal betting bouts to pay his mother's hospital bills. When Fakirappa watches him knock out a seasoned fighter in an underground match, he reluctantly agrees to train him for the state championship, on the condition that Raghu quits the illegal fights for good. The bookmakers who profit from Raghu's punches are not willing to let him go. As training intensifies, Raghu falls for Shruthi, a physiotherapist at the district hospital who patches him up after every bout. Gritty, sweaty and emotional, the film is a classic underdog boxing drama about redemption, family and the difference between fighting for money and fighting for something that truly matters.

title: Amavasye Raatri
synopsis: Every new moon night, the residents of a small village in the Malnad hills lock their doors at sunset and refuse to answer any knock. Journalist Sneha arrives to investigate a series of mysterious deaths that the local police have recorded as snakebites. Her guide is Prakash, a young schoolteacher who dismisses the superstitions but will not leave his home on new moon nights either. Sneha learns of a legend about a wronged woman whose spirit walks the village when the moon is dark, seeking the descendants of the men who betrayed her. As the next new moon approaches, she discovers that the deaths are linked to a land deal, a powerful family and a secret buried in the records of the village temple. Mixing folk horror with investigative thriller, the film builds its tension through darkness, silence and footsteps outside locked doors, leaving viewers unsure until the very end whether the killer is human or something else entirely.

title: Paper Lanterns Over Kyoto
synopsis: Claire Morgan, a translator from Seattle who has just lost her job to automated software, travels to Kyoto to settle the affairs of a Japanese novelist whose books she translated for fifteen years but never met. He has left her his unfinished final manuscript and a house full of paper lanterns he made by hand. Working with his reserved grandson Kenji, a carpenter who resents her presence, Claire tries to piece together the last chapters from notes scattered around the house. As they move through temples, tea houses and festivals in the old city, she realises the novel is about a love affair from the writer's youth, and that the woman in it may still be alive. The search brings her closer to Kenji and forces her to face her own fears about change and loneliness. Quiet, elegant and visually serene, the film is a reflective romance about language, memory and the meanings that are lost and found in translation.

title: The Glass Meridian
synopsis: Physicist Ezra Holt wakes every morning at 6.03 on the same Tuesday, in the same research facility in the Swiss Alps, where a particle experiment is scheduled to go live at noon. Each day ends at 12.07 with an explosion that destroys the lab and resets the loop, and Ezra is the only one who remembers. At first he tries to stop the experiment directly, then to warn his colleagues, but nothing works, and on some days the loop ends even earlier. Gradually he realises that another scientist, Dr Mira Kovac, is starting to remember fragments of previous days too, and that the loop may have been created deliberately. Together they must uncover who sabotaged the facility and why, using knowledge gathered over hundreds of repeated mornings. Smart and twisty, the film is a science-fiction mystery that turns the familiar time-loop idea into a puzzle about trust, guilt and the consequences of choices we keep trying to undo.

title: Bramble and the Clockwork Kingdom
synopsis: Bramble is a young mouse who lives in the walls of an old clockmaker's shop in a snowy European town, where the mice keep their own tiny kingdom running with scraps of gears and springs. When the elderly clockmaker falls ill and the shop's great tower clock stops, time in the mouse kingdom begins to go wrong: seasons skip, days repeat and the royal family freezes in place. Bramble, who has always been told she is too small and clumsy to be an inventor, sets out to repair the tower clock with the help of a vain pigeon, a timid beetle and a retired rat who once worked as the clockmaker's assistant. Their journey through ticking corridors, snowy rooftops and the shadow of a hungry cat tests her courage and her creativity. Packed with intricate mechanical worlds and warm humour, the film is a charming animated fantasy about believing in yourself and the friendships that keep everything moving.

title: Undertow at Pelican Bay
synopsis: When a teenage girl drowns at a private beach party in a wealthy Florida town, police quickly charge the young Haitian groundskeeper who pulled her from the water. Public defender Monica Reyes, overworked and close to quitting, is assigned the case and expects a quick plea deal. But the more she looks, the less the story holds together. The party was hosted by the son of the town's most powerful developer, witnesses have changed their statements, and the security footage has gone missing. With a stubborn private investigator and the victim's grieving father, who begins to doubt the official version, Monica uncovers a culture of silence protecting the town's elite. As the trial approaches, she faces pressure from her own office, threats against her family and a prosecutor determined to win at any cost. Gripping and morally serious, the film is a legal thriller about privilege, race and the courage it takes to challenge a community that would rather look away.

title: Kalari Kuttikal
synopsis: In a village near Vadakara in north Kerala, an old kalari, a training ground for the martial art of kalaripayattu, is about to be sold off by the family that owns it. Its ageing master, Raghavan Gurukkal, has only four students left, all of them children: his restless grandson Kichu, a shy girl named Ammu who practises in secret, a chubby boy who mostly comes for the snacks and a city kid sent to the village for the summer. When a property developer with a gang of hired muscle tries to force the sale, the children decide to save the kalari by entering a regional martial arts competition that offers prize money. Training under the strict old master, they learn the ancient forms, the discipline behind them and the value of standing together. Combining traditional martial arts choreography with lively comedy, the film is a family action drama about heritage, courage and the idea that real strength comes from character rather than size.

title: Shavappetti Shaji
synopsis: Shaji makes coffins in a small workshop behind a church in Thrissur, a trade inherited from his father and grandfather. Business has been slow because, as he complains to anyone who will listen, people in the parish have simply stopped dying. When a smooth-talking funeral entrepreneur from Kochi opens a modern funeral service with air-conditioned hearses and packaged ceremonies, Shaji's livelihood is threatened. His attempts to compete, from discount offers to designer coffins and a disastrous advertisement on local television, make him the talk of the town. Things get stranger when a wealthy old man orders a lavish coffin for himself and insists on trying it out, and Shaji becomes tangled up in the man's family feud over his will. Mixing dark humour with real tenderness, the film is a quirky comedy-drama about death, tradition and a stubborn craftsman who finally learns that the living matter more than the dead.

title: Mazhanoolukal
synopsis: Every monsoon, Aleena returns to her grandmother's homestay in the hills of Wayanad to escape her hectic advertising job in Bengaluru. This year she finds an unexpected guest: Vivek, a reserved botanist who has booked the only other room for the whole season to study rare orchids in the rainforest. They irritate each other immediately. He is meticulous and silent; she is chaotic and talkative. But as weeks of relentless rain cut off the roads and the power, they are forced into each other's company, sharing meals, walks through dripping forests and stories by candlelight. Aleena discovers that Vivek is racing to document the orchids before a resort project clears the forest, and she puts her own skills to work rallying support for his cause. Her grandmother, a sharp-tongued matchmaker, watches with amusement. Lush, slow and romantic, the film is a love story about two people learning to listen, set against the beauty and fragility of the Western Ghats in the rain.

title: Nizhalyudham
synopsis: When a senior scientist at a defence research laboratory in Thiruvananthapuram is found dead in his flat, the official explanation is a heart attack. Intelligence officer Arjun Menon is not convinced. The scientist had been working on a classified sonar system for the navy, and his last phone call was to a number in Colombo. Arjun's investigation brings him into contact with Nisha, the scientist's daughter, a marine biologist who suspects her father was being blackmailed. Together they follow a trail from fishing harbours and seaside resorts to a shipping company that appears to be a front for foreign agents. As Arjun closes in, he realises that someone inside his own agency is leaking his every move. Built around tense surveillance scenes, coastal chases and a cat-and-mouse game between rival spies, the film is a slick espionage thriller rooted in Kerala's coastline, where the line between friend and enemy keeps shifting with the tide.

title: Muthassiyude Bhootham
synopsis: When ninety-year-old Kalyani Amma dies peacefully in her sleep, her large, squabbling family gathers at the ancestral house in Ottapalam for the funeral and, more importantly, the reading of her will. Her great-grandson Unni, a ten-year-old who was the only one who visited her regularly, is the first to notice that she has not actually left: her ghost is sitting on the veranda, chewing betel leaves and complaining about the food. Only Unni can see her. Kalyani Amma has unfinished business, and she enlists the boy to help expose the relatives plotting to sell the house, reunite two estranged sisters and recover a box of letters hidden decades ago. Their adventures cause chaos at the funeral rituals, terrify a fake astrologer and gradually draw the family back together. Warm, funny and just a little spooky, the film is a family fantasy comedy about memory, love across generations and the stories that hold a family together.

title: Kovil Yaanai
synopsis: Muniyandi has been the mahout of Lakshmi, the elephant of a temple near Madurai, for thirty years. The two are inseparable: he talks to her, sings to her and sleeps beside her shed. When the temple trust decides to send the ageing elephant to a government rehabilitation camp after animal welfare activists complain about her chains, Muniyandi is heartbroken and insists that Lakshmi will not survive without him. His teenage daughter Selvi, who has grown up resenting the elephant who takes all her father's attention, unexpectedly becomes Lakshmi's champion. As the transfer date approaches, Muniyandi and Selvi take Lakshmi on one last temple festival procession, and then on an unplanned journey across villages and forests. Shot with real tenderness, the film is a moving family drama about the bond between people and animals, the ethics of captivity and a father and daughter slowly learning to understand each other.

title: Koyambedu Raja
synopsis: Koyambedu market in Chennai never sleeps: every night, tonnes of vegetables, fruit and flowers change hands under its sodium lights. Raja started there as a fourteen-year-old porter carrying sacks of onions; twenty years later, he controls the trucks, the loaders and the commission agents, and nothing moves without his permission. When a powerful politician tries to seize the market for a redevelopment project, Raja's empire comes under threat. At the same time, his younger brother Selvam, whom he put through college to keep him away from the market's violence, returns as a police officer assigned to clean up the trade. The two brothers find themselves on opposite sides of a war that drags in rival gangs, desperate farmers and Raja's fiercely loyal wife Valli. Set amid the market's chaotic nights and pre-dawn bustle, the film is a gritty action drama about loyalty, ambition and the bitter cost of power.

title: Nilavukku Oru Payanam
synopsis: Ten-year-old Thamizh lives in a fishing village near Rameswaram and dreams of becoming an astronaut. When her school is invited to a national competition to design an experiment that will fly on an upcoming lunar mission, she convinces her reluctant science teacher and three classmates to enter. They have no laboratory, no internet at home and a principal who thinks the whole idea is ridiculous. With help from her grandfather, a retired fisherman who knows the stars better than any textbook, and a lonely young engineer on holiday, the team builds a prototype from bicycle parts, plastic bottles and fishing nets. Their journey takes them to a science fair in Chennai and then to Bengaluru, where they face private school teams with expensive kits. Bright, inspiring and full of humour, the film is a children's adventure that celebrates curiosity, perseverance and the idea that great discoveries can come from the smallest places.

title: Thamarai Express Kollai
synopsis: A gang of hopeless robbers plans to hold up the Thamarai Express, a slow overnight train from Chennai to Tirunelveli, convinced that it is secretly carrying a crate of gold coins for a temple trust. Their leader, Sampath, is a failed actor who has watched far too many heist films, and his crew includes a nervous ticket examiner, a cook from the pantry car and a pickpocketing grandmother. What they do not know is that a smuggler's gang, an undercover police officer and a runaway bride are also on board, and that the gold crate is not what it seems. As the train crawls through the night, the robbery turns into a chain of mistaken identities, swapped luggage and slapstick brawls between coaches. Taking place almost entirely on board, the film is a fast-paced action comedy that packs in chases across the roof, a heist plan that collapses at every station and a surprising final twist.

title: Hostel No. 7
synopsis: Hostel No. 7 is the oldest and most run-down boys' hostel at an engineering college in Allahabad, home to the students nobody else wants: repeaters, troublemakers and those who cannot pay more. When the college announces that the hostel will be demolished to make way for a luxury block, the residents, led by a perpetual final-year student named Bunty and a nerdy newcomer named Prashant, decide to fight back. Their campaign involves protests, a disastrous cultural festival, an alliance with the girls' hostel and an investigation into the warden's suspicious contracts. Along the way, Prashant falls for Shalini, the sharp student union leader, and Bunty confronts the real reason he has stayed in college for nine years. Fast, funny and full of hostel chaos, the film is a coming-of-age comedy about friendship and youthful rebellion, and about the bonds formed in shabby rooms that somehow end up feeling like home.

title: Thar Ki Pyaas
synopsis: In a desert village in western Rajasthan, Kesar walks eight kilometres every morning to fetch water from a dwindling well, balancing three pots on her head. Married at sixteen and widowed at twenty-four, she lives with her mother-in-law and two young children. When a government engineer arrives to survey the village for a piped-water scheme and then vanishes along with the funds, Kesar decides she will not wait for anyone else to solve the problem. She revives an old system of rainwater harvesting that her grandmother once used, persuading the village women to work together despite opposition from the headman, who profits from selling tanker water. Her efforts attract a documentary filmmaker and, eventually, the attention of the state. Shot amid the stark beauty of the Thar desert, the film is a quiet, powerful drama about water, women's labour and the courage to change one's fate, inspired by grassroots conservation movements across the region.

title: Aaina Ke Peeche
synopsis: After a car accident leaves gaps in her memory, Nandini Rathore returns to her family's old mansion in Udaipur to recover. Her husband Vikram is attentive and kind, her doctor is encouraging and her younger sister has come to stay. But Nandini keeps seeing a woman in the mansion's mirrors who looks exactly like her, mouthing words she cannot understand. Her family insists it is a side effect of her medication. As she pieces together fragments of her own life, from a hidden diary to a locked room and a will she does not remember signing, Nandini begins to suspect that the accident was no accident and that someone in the house wants her to forget. Every person she trusts seems to be hiding something. Twisting and elegant, the film is a psychological thriller about identity, manipulation and inheritance, set in a sprawling lakeside haveli whose mirrors seem to reflect far more than they should.

title: Mohalla Cricket League
synopsis: In a crowded neighbourhood of old Lucknow, street cricket is a matter of life and death, and the annual Mohalla Cricket League decides who rules the lanes for a year. Pappu, a lazy but naturally gifted batsman, has lost the final three times to the team from across the main road, captained by his arrogant cousin Chintu. This year the stakes are higher: the winners get to decide whether the neighbourhood's only open ground becomes a parking lot. Pappu recruits a ragtag side that includes a retired umpire who refuses to watch, a girl who bowls faster than any boy in the area and a tea seller's son who has never held a bat. Their training sessions, rivalries and a series of increasingly ridiculous matches bring the whole community together. Rich with local humour, slang and affection for the game, the film is a feel-good sports comedy about friendship, family rivalry and the simple joy of cricket in narrow streets.

title: Konaseema Kathalu
synopsis: Set in the lush delta region of Konaseema, where coconut palms line the many branches of the Godavari, this anthology film tells four connected stories over a single festival season. A retired schoolteacher waits for his son from America, who may not come. A young boatman falls in love with a girl from a rich family across the river. A widowed woman starts a small business selling festival sweets despite her in-laws' disapproval. And a city photographer arrives to document the region's traditions and discovers his own roots. Each story touches the others in small ways, through a boat ride, a shared meal or a rooster that keeps escaping. With gentle humour, lyrical visuals and a rich folk soundtrack, the film celebrates rural Andhra life, its festivals, food and people, while quietly exploring migration, loneliness and the pull of home. It is a warm, unhurried portrait of a place and the lives woven through it.

title: Hero Avvali
synopsis: Sreenu has wanted to be a film hero since he was six, practising dance moves on his family's terrace in Nellore and memorising every line of his favourite star's films. At twenty-eight, after years of failed auditions in Hyderabad, he works as a junior artist in crowd scenes and shares a tiny room with three other dreamers. When a vlogger films him performing an over-the-top dialogue on the street and the clip goes viral, a shady producer offers him the lead in a low-budget film, on the condition that Sreenu finds the money himself. His desperate attempts to raise funds, from selling his father's land to borrowing from loan sharks, lead to comic chaos and real heartbreak. Meanwhile his childhood friend Divya, now an assistant director, tries to make him see what he is truly good at. Funny and affectionate, the film is a satire of the Telugu film industry and a tribute to everyone who dreams of the big screen.

title: Kaala Bhairava Kshetram
synopsis: In a remote temple town deep in the forest, a centuries-old shrine to Kaala Bhairava is believed to protect the region from evil. When a mining company bribes officials to blast the hill on which the temple stands, strange deaths begin among the workers, and villagers claim that the god's fury has been awakened. Surya, a sceptical army veteran who has returned to his native village, is drawn into the conflict when his younger brother is killed. Teaming up with Priya, a journalist investigating the company's illegal operations, he uncovers ancient secrets about the temple and a group of guardians sworn to protect it. As the blasting deadline approaches, Surya must choose between his rational beliefs and the mysterious forces that seem to be guiding him. Combining mythology, supernatural thrills and large-scale action, the film is a mass entertainer with spectacular set pieces in forests, caves and the ancient temple itself.

title: Lakshmi Tiffin Centre
synopsis: Lakshmi runs a small breakfast stall outside a Guntur bus stand, serving idli, dosa and pesarattu to bus drivers, students and labourers before dawn. Her husband walked out years ago, and she has raised her son Kiran alone on the money from the stall. When Kiran, now a software engineer in Hyderabad, announces his engagement to a girl from a wealthy family, Lakshmi is thrilled, until the bride's family makes it clear that they are embarrassed by her humble trade. Kiran asks her to close the stall before the wedding. Hurt but determined, Lakshmi decides instead to enter a televised cooking competition, hoping to prove her worth. Her journey through the contest, with help from her loyal customers and a gruff rival chef, changes how her son and his new family see her. Warm, funny and emotional, the film is a family drama about dignity, motherhood and food that carries a lifetime of love.

title: Kannada Meshtru
synopsis: Basavaraju has taught Kannada at a government school in Bengaluru for thirty-two years, watching enrolment fall every year as parents move their children to English-medium private schools. When the education department announces that the school will be merged and closed, Basavaraju, just months from retirement, decides to fight. He goes door to door in the neighbourhood, organises poetry recitals, stages plays and starts free evening classes for migrant children who speak neither Kannada nor English. His efforts are mocked by colleagues, ignored by officials and opposed by a property developer with his eye on the school's land. Slowly, though, the community begins to rally behind the stubborn teacher, and his own grandson, who barely speaks the language, finds his way back to it. Heartfelt and gently humorous, the film is a drama about language, identity and the teachers who keep cultures alive one classroom at a time.

title: Panambur Beach Gang
synopsis: Four small-time crooks in Mangaluru spend their days running petty scams at Panambur Beach, selling fake pearls to tourists and organising rigged games at festivals. When they accidentally steal a bag belonging to a dangerous smuggler, they find themselves holding a fortune in diamonds and being hunted by gangsters from Mumbai, a crooked local police inspector and the smuggler's furious girlfriend. Their leader, the excitable Ronnie, wants to sell the diamonds and leave town; the others want to give them back and survive. Their attempts to do both lead them through fish markets, toddy shops, a Yakshagana performance and a wedding at a coastal mansion. Along the way they team up with Prema, a sharp-witted fish seller who has her own reasons for wanting the smuggler caught. Packed with coastal flavour, Tulu-inflected humour and energetic action, the film is a breezy crime comedy that never takes itself too seriously.

title: Reshme Seere
synopsis: In a weavers' colony near Mysuru, Gowramma has spent forty years weaving silk saris on a handloom, the same work her mother and grandmother did. Her son wants her to sell the loom and move to Bengaluru, where he works in a call centre, and her granddaughter Megha, a fashion design student, thinks the old patterns are boring. When a large textile company starts selling cheap machine-made copies of the colony's traditional designs, the weavers' livelihood collapses. Megha, assigned a college project on traditional textiles, reluctantly returns to the colony and begins learning to weave from her grandmother. As she discovers the skill, patience and history behind each sari, she comes up with a plan to help the weavers protect their designs and reach new buyers. A romance with a young lawyer helping the weavers adds warmth. Rich in colour and texture, the film is a heartfelt drama about craft, heritage and the threads that connect generations.

title: Data Center 9
synopsis: Bengaluru's newest data centre, a windowless fortress on the edge of the city, stores the personal records of half the country's citizens. When a junior systems engineer, Akash, notices that someone is quietly copying millions of records every night, he reports it to his manager and is fired the next morning for supposedly stealing the data himself. Framed and on the run, he turns to his former college friend Divya, now an ethical hacker who runs a small cybersecurity firm. Together they discover that the theft is part of a plan to manipulate an upcoming election using personal data and targeted messages. To clear Akash's name and expose the conspiracy, they must break back into the data centre on the one night its security systems are being upgraded. Taut and contemporary, the film is a cyber thriller that combines a heist with a pointed warning about privacy, surveillance and who controls information in the digital age.

title: Seventeen Votes
synopsis: When a long-serving senator in a Midwestern state dies suddenly, his chief of staff, Helen Marsh, finds herself responsible for securing seventeen votes in the state legislature to pass his final bill, a healthcare reform that would keep rural hospitals open. She has nine days. Helen is joined by Daniel Osei, an idealistic young intern, and a cynical old lobbyist who has switched sides more times than anyone can count. Their efforts lead them through late-night negotiations, backroom deals, family dinners in small towns and confrontations with a powerful insurance company that wants the bill dead. Helen must decide how many compromises she is willing to make to win, and whether the senator she worked for was really as principled as she believed. Smart, fast-talking and grounded in the mechanics of politics, the film is a political drama about idealism, pragmatism and the messy business of making laws.

title: Thin Air Over Patagonia
synopsis: A small charter plane carrying five passengers across the Andes crash-lands on a glacier in Patagonia after a sudden storm. The survivors include an Argentine pilot with a broken leg, a British geologist, a young Chilean mother, a wealthy American businessman and his teenage son. With little food, no radio and freezing temperatures, they must decide whether to wait for a rescue that may never come or attempt a dangerous trek across the ice to a distant ranger station. Tensions rise as supplies dwindle and secrets emerge: the businessman is fleeing fraud charges, and the pilot may have been paid to take a risky route. As the group splits, the teenage boy and the young mother form an unlikely partnership that may be their best chance of survival. Filmed amid spectacular glaciers and peaks, the film is a gripping survival adventure about endurance, trust and what people become when civilisation is stripped away.

title: The Baker of Rue Lantier
synopsis: Every morning at five, Jules Marchand opens his family bakery on a quiet street in Paris, just as his father and grandfather did. Business is struggling, the landlord wants to raise the rent and Jules is too shy to talk to Sophie, the American illustrator who buys a croissant from him every day and sketches the street from the café opposite. When Sophie's drawings of the bakery go viral online, tourists begin queuing around the block, and Jules finds himself overwhelmed by sudden fame. His attempts to keep up, with help from his grandmother, a temperamental apprentice and a stray dog, lead to burnt baguettes, a small kitchen fire and a disastrous television interview. Meanwhile, Sophie is wrestling with her own decision about whether to stay in Paris. Light, charming and full of the warm glow of fresh bread, the film is a romantic comedy about small businesses, quiet courage and the sweetness of everyday routines.

title: Cosmo and the Comet Chasers
synopsis: Cosmo is an eleven-year-old who lives with his inventor grandmother on a small farm far from city lights, where the night sky is crowded with stars. When a rare comet is predicted to pass close to Earth, Cosmo discovers that it has dropped a tiny alien creature who needs to get home before the comet disappears for another thousand years. With the help of his best friend Nova, a scrappy neighbour who builds rockets in her barn, and his grandmother's half-finished inventions, Cosmo sets out to send the creature home. They are pursued by a government agent obsessed with capturing proof of alien life and a television astronomer who wants the glory for himself. Their adventure takes them from the farm to a desert observatory and finally to a launch site where everything is on the line. Colourful, funny and full of wonder, the film is an animated family adventure about friendship, curiosity and the joy of looking up at the sky.

title: Vote Cheyyu Vasu
synopsis: Vasu is a cheerful loafer in a small town near Kollam who has never voted, never read a newspaper and never held a steady job. When a clerical error makes him the decisive voter in a council by-election, after every other ballot in his ward ends in a perfect tie, the town's three major parties suddenly need him. Overnight, Vasu becomes the most important man in town. Party workers shower him with gifts, a television channel follows him everywhere and his long-suffering girlfriend Shalini watches in disbelief as he enjoys every minute of it. But as the bribes grow bigger and the threats grow darker, Vasu begins to ask questions he never bothered with before: what do these parties actually stand for, and what does his town really need? Sharp, silly and pointed, the film is a political satire that pokes fun at every side while making an earnest case for the power of a single, thoughtful vote.

title: Sevens Sultan
synopsis: In Malappuram, the dusty sevens football tournaments that run through the winter draw crowds of thousands, with local clubs hiring players from as far away as West Africa. Shameer runs a struggling club that has not won a trophy in years, held together by his late father's reputation and a great deal of borrowed money. When his star striker is poached by a rich rival club, Shameer gambles everything on an untested young player from Ghana named Kwame, who arrives in Kerala knowing nothing of the language and hiding an injury. As the season unfolds, the two form an unlikely friendship, and Kwame is gradually adopted by Shameer's chaotic household, including a grandmother who insists on feeding him every hour. With the final against their rivals approaching, debt collectors circling and Kwame's visa running out, Shameer must decide what matters more: winning or doing right by his friend. The film is a warm, energetic sports drama about football, hospitality and friendship across borders.

title: Thayambaka Thampuran
synopsis: Krishnankutty Marar is one of the most celebrated chenda drummers in Kerala, a temperamental genius whose thayambaka performances draw crowds to temple festivals across the state. When a stroke leaves his right hand partly paralysed, he retreats into bitter silence, refusing to see his students or even his family. His estranged son Hari, a sound engineer working on film scores in Chennai, returns home to care for him and discovers the depth of his father's despair. Reluctantly, Hari takes up the drum his father once forced on him as a child, and the two begin a difficult journey of teaching and learning, with the old master instructing from his chair and the son rediscovering an art he had rejected. With a major festival approaching, where the family has performed for generations, Hari must decide whether he will play. Pulsing with rhythm and music, the film is a heartfelt drama about art, legacy and a father and son finding a common beat.

title: Ammini Evide?
synopsis: When eight-year-old Ammini disappears from a crowded church festival in a hill town near Kottayam, the local police assume she has wandered off and will turn up by morning. She does not. Her mother Rosily, a nurse home on leave from the Gulf, refuses to let the case be forgotten, and an unlikely investigator steps forward: Sub-Inspector Benny, recently suspended for misconduct and desperate for redemption. As the search spreads through rubber plantations, abandoned quarries and the homes of neighbours, suspicion falls on one person after another: a reclusive photographer, a debt-ridden uncle, a travelling balloon seller and even Rosily's estranged husband. Each lead exposes hidden secrets in the close-knit community. Told with tension and compassion, the film is a gripping mystery that is as interested in the grief and guilt of a whole town as in the question of what happened to Ammini, building to a revelation that changes everything.

title: Kunjunniyum Ponnaamayum
synopsis: Kunjunni is a small, curious boy who lives on a houseboat on the backwaters of Kuttanad with his grandmother, a storyteller who knows every legend of the lakes. One stormy night he rescues a golden turtle caught in a fishing net, and the turtle reveals that she is the guardian of the backwaters, weakened by pollution and plastic. To restore her strength, Kunjunni must travel to the source of the river in the Western Ghats and bring back a magical seed. Joined by a mischievous kingfisher and a grumpy old crab, he sets off on a journey through paddy fields, mangroves, temple ponds and misty forests, meeting creatures who need his help along the way. A sneaky businessman who wants to drain the lake for a resort tries to stop him. Bright, colourful and rooted in Kerala's landscapes and folklore, the film is an animated family adventure about friendship, courage and caring for the natural world.

title: Varmakalai Vaathiyar
synopsis: In a village near Kanyakumari, sixty-year-old Arumugam is a traditional healer and master of varmakalai, the ancient southern martial art of pressure points, though he has not used it to fight in decades. He runs a small clinic treating sprains and fractures and teaches the art only to his grandson Velu. When a powerful sand-mining gang begins terrorising the village, beating protesters and threatening the river, Velu wants to fight back, but Arumugam forbids it, haunted by a violent incident from his own youth. When Velu is badly hurt and the gang targets the village's water source, the old master must decide whether to break his vow of non-violence. Featuring precise, grounded fight choreography inspired by the art itself, the film is an action drama about tradition, restraint and the responsibility that comes with power, set against the striking landscape where three seas meet at India's southern tip.

title: Nilgiri Toy Train Kaadhal
synopsis: Arun is a Chennai architect sent to the hill town of Coonoor to supervise the renovation of an old railway station for a heritage tourism project. Every morning he rides the slow mountain railway up the hills, and every morning he ends up in the same compartment as Mythili, a sharp-witted schoolteacher who strongly opposes his project, convinced it will push out the small shops and vendors who depend on the station. Their daily arguments become a source of entertainment for the regular passengers, a group of tea planters, schoolchildren and an old guard who has worked on the line for forty years. As Arun learns more about the town and its people, he begins to rethink his plans, and Mythili starts to see that he may not be the villain she imagined. Gentle, scenic and full of charm, the film is a romantic comedy set amid misty tea gardens, tunnels and viaducts, celebrating slow journeys of every kind.

title: Chettinad Maaligai
synopsis: When the matriarch of a wealthy Chettiar household dies, her grandchildren gather at the sprawling ancestral mansion in Karaikudi for the first time in fifteen years. The mansion, with its Burma teak pillars, Italian tiles and endless courtyards, is falling into ruin, and the heirs are eager to sell it to a hotel chain. But the matriarch's will contains an unusual instruction: the house cannot be sold until a missing family heirloom, a diamond necklace lost in the 1960s, is found. As the cousins search the mansion's hidden rooms and storerooms, they uncover old letters, forgotten scandals and the story of a great-aunt who was erased from the family's history. Old rivalries flare, and someone seems willing to do anything to find the necklace first. Rich in atmosphere and set in one of Tamil Nadu's most striking architectural traditions, the film is a family mystery drama about inheritance, secrets and the women whose stories were hidden behind ornate doors.

title: Like Share Subscribe Subbu
synopsis: Subramaniam, known to everyone as Subbu, is a fifty-two-year-old bank clerk in Tiruchirappalli who has spent his life being careful, polite and invisible. When his teenage daughter secretly records him singing old film songs while cooking and posts the clip online, it goes viral, and Subbu wakes up to find himself an internet celebrity. Brands want him to promote products, a talent manager signs him up and strangers stop him in the street for selfies. At first Subbu enjoys the attention, but as he chases likes and followers, he begins to neglect his job, his family and the simple pleasures that once made him happy. His wife watches with growing alarm, and his daughter feels guilty for starting it all. When a controversial video threatens to destroy his reputation overnight, Subbu has to decide who he really is. Funny and pointed, the film is a satire about social media fame and the pressure of performing a life online.

title: Biji Goes to Goa
synopsis: Seventy-four-year-old Biji has never left Ludhiana except for weddings and funerals. When her husband dies, she finds a list of places he always promised to take her, and Goa is at the top. Her sons are horrified at the idea, so Biji quietly books a train ticket and leaves a note. Her granddaughter Simran, a burnt-out advertising executive, is sent to bring her back, but Biji has other plans. In Goa, the two women stay at a crumbling guesthouse run by a retired Goan singer, attend beach parties, learn to swim and fall in with a group of elderly tourists from Pune who are on an adventure of their own. Biji discovers a taste for freedom she never knew she had, while Simran begins to question her own life. When the whole family descends on Goa to drag Biji home, the women must stand up for their choices. Bright and heartwarming, the film is a comedy about freedom, ageing and living fully at any age.

title: Barrack No. 4
synopsis: Wrongly convicted of a murder he did not commit, schoolteacher Abhay Mathur is sent to a crowded jail on the outskirts of Delhi, where he is assigned to Barrack No. 4, home to the prison's most hardened inmates. Educated, frightened and unused to violence, Abhay is quickly targeted by a ruthless gang leader. To survive, he begins teaching the barrack's inmates to read, write and draft their own legal appeals, earning protection and slowly becoming a respected figure. His classes attract a mix of characters: a young pickpocket, a former wrestler, an undertrial who has waited nine years for his case to be heard and an elderly man who never learned to write his name. As Abhay's own appeal stalls, he discovers that his conviction was arranged by someone powerful. The film is a gripping prison drama about injustice, education and the dignity of people the system forgets, with sharp performances and an unflinching portrait of life behind bars.

title: Ghazal Ki Galiyaan
synopsis: In the old lanes of Lucknow, Rehaan is a young singer who earns a living performing at weddings and private gatherings, but dreams of becoming a ghazal singer like the masters he grew up hearing on his grandfather's radio. When he hears Noor, a reserved teacher of Urdu poetry, recite her verses at a mushaira, he falls for both her words and her voice. Noor is engaged to a wealthy businessman's son, and her family has no interest in a struggling musician. Rehaan begins setting her poems to music, and their collaboration becomes a secret romance conducted through ghazals performed at gatherings across the city. When a music producer from Mumbai offers Rehaan a career-changing contract, on the condition that he sing commercial songs instead of the poetry he loves, he faces a painful choice. Rich with original songs, poetry and the nostalgic beauty of old Lucknow, the film is a musical romance about art, love and staying true to one's own voice.

title: Peepal Ke Neeche
synopsis: Shruti and her husband Kabir buy an old house in a village outside Varanasi, planning to turn it into a homestay for foreign tourists. In the courtyard stands an enormous peepal tree that the villagers warn them never to cut, and nobody will work in the house after sunset. The couple dismiss the warnings as superstition until strange things begin to happen: whispers at night, footprints in the dust, and Shruti waking under the tree with no memory of how she got there. Kabir grows distant and irritable, and the couple's young house help disappears. Digging into the house's history, Shruti uncovers the dark story of a newly married woman who died in the courtyard decades earlier and a family that covered up her death. Atmospheric and unsettling, the film is a supernatural horror thriller that draws on old beliefs about trees and spirits to explore guilt, injustice and the ghosts of the past.

title: Nagali Gurtu
synopsis: In a drought-hit village in the Rayalaseema region, farmer Venkatesh has watched his crops fail for three years and his debts grow beyond anything he can repay. When a neighbour takes his own life, Venkatesh's son Ravi, a political science student in Tirupati, returns home angry and determined to change things. Ravi organises farmers to demand fair prices and irrigation, clashing with a powerful local politician who controls the cooperative bank and the seed dealers. Meanwhile Venkatesh, a quiet man who distrusts politics, tries to save his land by experimenting with millets and other hardy crops that his grandfather once grew. The tension between father and son, between protest and patience, drives the drama as the village heads toward a confrontation. Grounded in rural realities, the film is a powerful drama about farming, dignity and the struggles of Indian farmers, with an ending that offers both hard truths and quiet hope.

title: Alien Ammayi
synopsis: Sravan is an unlucky software engineer in Hyderabad whose parents keep arranging bride-viewing meetings that always go wrong. Then a mysterious young woman named Tara literally falls from the sky onto his apartment balcony during a meteor shower. She claims to be from a distant planet, on a mission to study human emotions, and she has chosen Sravan as her research subject. At first he thinks she is a prankster, but her strange abilities, from talking to electronics to freezing time for a few seconds, convince him otherwise. To keep her secret, Sravan introduces her to his family as his fiancée, setting off chaos with his traditional parents, nosy relatives and a government scientist hunting for proof of extraterrestrial life. As Tara learns about love, jealousy and family, Sravan begins to fall for her, knowing she must eventually leave. Light, colourful and gleefully silly, the film is a romantic sci-fi comedy about a love that crosses galaxies.

title: Chess Champion Chinna
synopsis: Chinna is a nine-year-old who helps his father run a tea stall at a bus stand in Ongole, where he spends his free moments watching old men play chess on a cardboard board. With astonishing speed he picks up the game and begins beating everyone at the stand. A retired schoolteacher, Ramana Rao, recognises his talent and offers to coach him, but Chinna's father, who struggles to make ends meet, sees chess as a distraction from work. With the teacher's help and his mother's quiet support, Chinna begins entering tournaments, facing well-funded opponents with professional coaches and computers. His journey takes him from district competitions to a national championship in Chennai, where the pressure, the loneliness and the cost of travel push his family to the limit. Inspiring and heartfelt, the film is a sports drama about talent, poverty and the sacrifices families make for their children's dreams, with tense, cleverly staged matches.

title: Rishikonda Rahasyam
synopsis: When a wealthy businessman is found dead in his clifftop villa above Rishikonda beach near Visakhapatnam, the local police declare it a suicide. Inspector Bhaskar, newly posted to the city after a disciplinary transfer, is unconvinced, especially once he learns that the man had recently changed his will and that three people stood to gain from his death: his young second wife, his estranged son and his business partner. Bhaskar teams up with Sahithi, a forensic analyst who notices details everyone else has missed, to reconstruct the businessman's final night. Their investigation uncovers a web of lies, secret affairs and a decades-old crime connected to the villa itself. As they close in on the truth, a second murder suggests that the killer is still watching. Atmospheric and tightly plotted, the film is a classic whodunit set against Visakhapatnam's beaches and hills, keeping the audience guessing until its final reveal.

title: Mahishuru Mahal
synopsis: In 1936, the royal court of Mysore is one of the great centres of Carnatic music, and its palace musicians are honoured like nobility. Venkatesha, a gifted young veena player from a poor village family, is accepted as a junior musician in the palace orchestra after a chance audition. He is mentored by the court's ageing chief musician, a strict but generous master, and falls in love with Kamala, a singer whose talent is overlooked because she is a woman. As the Dasara festival approaches, a rivalry with a powerful senior musician threatens Venkatesha's place, and the shifting politics of the princely state hint at the changes coming with India's freedom struggle. Kamala, meanwhile, dreams of performing in the palace durbar, something no woman has yet done. Lavishly recreated with palace interiors, costumes and soaring music, the film is a period musical drama about art, ambition and the courage to challenge tradition.

title: Bengaluru Bachelors
synopsis: Four young men from different corners of Karnataka share a cramped flat in Bengaluru's Koramangala: a software engineer terrified of his manager, a struggling stand-up comedian, an MBA student who lies to his parents about his marks and a gym trainer with a heart of gold. Their chaotic lives are thrown into disarray when their landlord's niece, Shruthi, moves into the flat above and announces that she has been put in charge of making the building family-friendly. The bachelors launch a series of schemes to drive her out, from staged ghost sightings to fake complaints, but each one backfires spectacularly. Meanwhile Shruthi has her own reasons for moving in, and one of the flatmates begins to fall for her. Packed with city traffic, late-night food runs, start-up jargon and the pleasures and pains of shared living, the film is a breezy romantic comedy about friendship, independence and growing up in a big city.

title: Agumbe Raatri
synopsis: Five college friends from Bengaluru drive to the rainforest village of Agumbe for a weekend of trekking and photography during the monsoon. Their homestay host, an old woman who lives alone with her grandson, warns them never to enter the forest after dark. They ignore her. When one of the friends disappears during a night walk to photograph frogs, the others begin a frantic search through the dripping, leech-filled forest. Strange sounds, abandoned huts and an injured forest guard suggest that something, or someone, is hunting them. As the remaining friends turn on one another, old resentments and secrets surface, and the line between a human predator and the forest's legends begins to blur. Shot in rain and darkness with a pounding sound design, the film is a tense survival thriller with touches of horror, set in one of the wettest places in India, where the forest itself seems to be alive and watching.

title: Hasiru Hudugaru
synopsis: When the only playground in their Hubballi neighbourhood is fenced off for a commercial complex, five children aged nine to twelve decide to fight back. Led by Chinnu, a bossy girl who wants to be a lawyer, the gang includes a quiet boy who knows the name of every bird, twins who never stop arguing and a newcomer from Delhi who is still learning Kannada. Their campaign starts small, with posters and petitions, and grows into a full-scale environmental adventure when they discover that the land is home to an ancient tree that may be protected by law. With help from a retired forest officer and a grandmother who once led protests of her own, the children take on a property developer, a corrupt official and their own nervous parents. Bright, funny and inspiring, the film is a children's adventure about friendship, activism and the importance of green spaces in fast-growing cities.

title: Below the Ardennes
synopsis: In the winter of 1944, as a German offensive rages through the forests above them, a small group of American and British soldiers become trapped in an abandoned Belgian coal mine after their unit is overrun. Their only guide is Marthe, a miner's daughter who knows the tunnels and is secretly sheltering a group of Jewish children from the occupying forces. With little food, failing lamps and patrols searching the mine entrances, the soldiers must decide whether to try to break out and rejoin their lines or stay and protect the children. Tensions rise between a hardened sergeant who wants to fight, a young medic who refuses to leave the wounded and a cynical British officer who may not be who he claims. Claustrophobic and emotionally charged, the film is a wartime survival drama that unfolds largely underground, exploring courage, sacrifice and the moral choices ordinary people make in extraordinary circumstances.

title: Saint Agnes Street Revue
synopsis: In a fading neighbourhood of New Orleans, the Saint Agnes Street Revue was once the most famous variety show in the city, a mix of jazz, comedy and dance that ran every Saturday night for forty years. Now its theatre is boarded up and set to become a parking garage. When retired showgirl Lorraine Dubois hears the news, she rallies the surviving performers, including a deaf tap dancer, a former magician, a bickering comedy duo and a gospel singer who has not sung in years, to stage one final show. Her granddaughter Kiara, a music producer with little patience for nostalgia, reluctantly agrees to help and finds herself drawn into an old world she never understood. Rehearsals are chaotic, money is short and the developer is watching. Filled with original songs, big dance numbers and warm comedy, the film is a joyful musical about community, ageing and the stubborn magic of live performance.

title: Flat 6, Ashgrove Road
synopsis: When freelance illustrator Rachel Hale moves into a cheap flat in a Victorian terrace in Edinburgh, she is delighted by the low rent and the friendly landlord. The only odd detail is a locked door at the end of the hallway, which the landlord says leads to a storage cupboard. Soon Rachel begins hearing footsteps behind it at night, finding her sketches rearranged and receiving letters addressed to a previous tenant who vanished two years earlier. Her neighbours insist that nobody else lives in the building. As she investigates, Rachel discovers that every tenant of Flat 6 has left suddenly, and that each of them was an artist. When she finally opens the locked door, she finds something that makes her question her own sanity. Tense and claustrophobic, the film is a psychological horror story that keeps the audience guessing whether the threat is supernatural, human or entirely inside Rachel's own mind.

title: The Seal Keeper's Summer
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Molly is sent to spend the summer with her grandfather, a gruff seal-rescue volunteer who lives alone on a remote island off the coast of Cornwall, while her parents finalise their divorce. She arrives sulking and determined to hate everything. But when a storm washes an injured seal pup onto the beach, Molly finds herself helping her grandfather nurse it back to health, and slowly the island, its wildlife and its eccentric residents win her over. She befriends a local boy who knows every cove and cave, learns to sail a small boat and discovers her grandfather's own heartbreaking reasons for living in isolation. When a property developer threatens to build a holiday resort on the seals' breeding beach, Molly leads a campaign to protect it. Gentle, sun-drenched and full of the sea, the film is a family drama about healing, nature and the unexpected friendships that can change a summer and a life.

title: Bumper Adichu Babu
synopsis: Babu is a lazy, lovable lottery seller at a bus stand in Kollam who has spent twenty years selling tickets to others without ever winning anything himself. On the eve of Onam, a customer fails to collect a ticket he reserved, and the next morning that ticket wins the festival bumper prize worth several crores. Babu now faces an ethical dilemma and an even bigger practical problem: the customer cannot be found, and half the town seems to know about the ticket. As Babu tries to track down the rightful owner, he is pursued by greedy relatives, a smooth-talking financier, a local politician and a gang of crooks, while his wife Mini insists that the money will bring nothing but trouble. A frantic chase across festival markets, boat races and family feasts follows. Bright, chaotic and big-hearted, the film is a family comedy about honesty, luck and what really makes a person rich.

title: Ponmudi Paathayil
synopsis: A young couple from Thiruvananthapuram, Nikhil and Ann, set out on a late-night drive up the winding hairpin road to the hill station of Ponmudi, hoping to repair a marriage that has been falling apart. Halfway up, they hit something in the fog. When they step out, there is nothing on the road, only a broken bracelet and a line of footprints leading into the forest. Shaken, they continue to their resort, but strange phone calls, a missing guest and a police officer who seems to know more than he should convince them that something terrible happened on that road. Nikhil wants to forget it; Ann insists on finding out the truth. As the night wears on, secrets between the couple come to light, and it becomes clear that the accident was no accident. Tightly wound and atmospheric, the film is a mystery thriller that uses fog, hairpin bends and dense forest to build a mounting sense of dread.

title: Anjal Petti
synopsis: In 1986, Raghavan is the village postman in a remote hamlet in the hills of Idukki, carrying letters, money orders and news on foot across tea estates and forest paths. For many villagers, especially the families of men working in the Gulf, he is the only link to the outside world, and he reads letters aloud to those who cannot read them. When a new telephone exchange arrives in the village and his job comes under threat, Raghavan is forced to consider what will become of him and the community he serves. His teenage daughter Latha, who dreams of becoming a teacher, writes secret letters to a pen friend in Delhi, and his wife has been waiting years for word from a brother who vanished in the Gulf. Told through the rhythms of daily deliveries, the film is a tender, nostalgic family drama about communication, change and the quiet heroism of ordinary public servants.

title: Ozone Junction
synopsis: In a sleepy village in Palakkad, an eccentric retired science teacher known as Professor Kuttappan claims that his homemade machine can repair the hole in the ozone layer, and everyone laughs at him. Then, during a thunderstorm, the machine gives off a strange green glow, and suddenly the village becomes a hotspot of bizarre happenings: mangoes ripen in seconds, cows produce fizzy milk and the local toddy tapper can hear radio broadcasts inside his head. News spreads, and the village is flooded with television crews, government scientists, conspiracy theorists and a multinational company eager to buy the machine. The professor's nephew Akhil, an unemployed engineer, and Divya, a sharp young journalist, try to work out what is really going on before the company gets its hands on the invention. Zany, colourful and gently satirical, the film is a science-fiction comedy about curiosity, greed and the stubborn wisdom of small communities.

title: Pranaya Metro
synopsis: Every day, the Kochi Metro carries thousands of commuters, and among the people who keep it running are Akhil, a nervous young announcer whose calm, friendly voice is loved by passengers, and Neha, a sharp train operator who drives between Aluva and the city. They have never met, but they talk every day over the operations radio, sharing jokes and quiet moments between stations. When an online campaign begins searching for the mysterious voice behind the announcements, Akhil panics, and Neha, who has fallen for him without knowing what he looks like, decides to find him herself. Their attempts to meet are thwarted by a jealous colleague, a nosy station master, a monsoon downpour and Akhil's own crippling shyness. Set among the metro's stations, viaducts and riverside views, the film is a breezy modern romance about connection, anonymity and the courage it takes to show the world who you really are.

title: Pattasu Pengal
synopsis: In the fireworks factories around Sivakasi, thousands of women spend their days rolling paper tubes and filling them with chemicals for a few hundred rupees a week. Muthulakshmi has worked there since she was eleven and now supervises a team of women at a small unit owned by a respected local businessman. When an explosion at a neighbouring factory kills several workers, she realises how dangerous her own unit is, with banned chemicals, locked exits and children hidden in back rooms. Supported by a young labour inspector and a hesitant group of co-workers, she begins to demand safer conditions, a decision that puts her job, her family and her life at risk. With the Diwali rush approaching and orders piling up, the factory owner will stop at nothing to keep the women quiet. Powerful and unsentimental, the film is a drama about labour, safety and the women whose work lights up the country's biggest festival.

title: Marina Muthu
synopsis: Muthu is a lifeguard at Chennai's Marina Beach who has saved more than a hundred people from its treacherous currents. He is also a former boxer whose career ended after a fight he refuses to talk about. When a teenage girl drowns amid a festival crowd and her death is quickly blamed on his negligence, Muthu is suspended and publicly shamed. Convinced she did not drown by accident, he begins investigating with the help of Sudha, a fisherwoman who saw something that night, and uncovers links to a gang running illegal sand and drug operations along the coast. As the gang targets him and his fellow lifeguards, Muthu is pulled back into the violence he left behind. With action scenes staged on the sand, in fishing harbours and in the stormy sea itself, the film is a muscular action drama about guilt, courage and the unsung people who guard the city's beloved shoreline.

title: Pei Veedu Thevai
synopsis: Three struggling bachelors in Chennai, unable to afford the city's rents, hit upon a brilliant idea: they will rent a house rumoured to be haunted, because nobody else will take it. The house is huge, cheap and full of old furniture. On the first night they discover that the rumours are true, and that the resident ghost, a strict retired headmistress who died in the house, is horrified by their messy habits. Instead of scaring them away, she decides to reform them. Soon the bachelors are waking at five, eating vegetables and studying for government exams under her supervision, while trying to hide her from a greedy landlord, a fake exorcist and a girl one of them hopes to impress. When the landlord plans to demolish the house, ghost and tenants must work together to save it. Loud, silly and warm, the film is a horror comedy that turns a haunted-house story into an unlikely tale of family.

title: Iyanthira Paravai
synopsis: Kathir is a young drone engineer at a Coimbatore start-up that builds agricultural drones to help farmers spray crops and map their fields. When one of his drones is hijacked in mid-air and used to smuggle contraband across a state border, Kathir is arrested and his company's licence is suspended. Determined to clear his name, he discovers that the hijacking was carried out by a sophisticated criminal network capable of seizing control of almost any drone in the country. With help from Malar, a cyber-crime officer who suspects there is more to the case, Kathir builds a counter-system to track the hackers. The hunt takes them from testing fields and electronics markets to a hidden control centre where the network is planning something far bigger. Featuring inventive aerial sequences and a clever technical plot, the film is a sci-fi thriller about innovation, security and the dangers of powerful technology in the wrong hands.

title: Chunav Chacha
synopsis: Ramesh Prasad, known to his town in Bihar as Chunav Chacha, has contested every election for thirty years, from the panchayat to Parliament, and lost every single one. He never campaigns seriously, spends almost nothing and treats each election as a festival. This year his nephew Bunty, a political science graduate who has returned from Delhi without a job, decides to run his uncle's campaign as a joke, using social media and street theatre. To everyone's astonishment, Chunav Chacha's honest, funny speeches about potholes, power cuts and empty promises begin to catch on, and the established parties start to panic. As the campaign gathers momentum, Bunty and his uncle face threats, bribes, fake news and the uncomfortable possibility that they might actually win. Sharp and big-hearted, the film is a political satire about democracy, hope and the absurdity of elections, anchored by a lovable underdog who refuses to stop believing in the system.

title: Dhanush Ki Dor
synopsis: Sukhmani is a fourteen-year-old girl from a tribal village in Jharkhand who has grown up hunting birds with a bamboo bow. When a talent scout from a sports academy in Ranchi sees her hit a moving target from a remarkable distance, she is offered a place in the academy's archery programme. In the city she struggles with the language, the food, the modern equipment and the condescension of wealthier athletes. Her coach, a former international archer named Mahesh Rawat who left the sport under a cloud, is harsh and unforgiving, but he believes she can reach the national team. Back home, her family is under pressure to sell their land to a mining company, and Sukhmani feels torn between her ambition and her responsibilities. As the national championship approaches, she must find a way to compete on her own terms. Stirring and grounded, the film is a sports drama about talent, identity and the hidden champions of India's tribal heartland.

title: Kanpur Ke Kissey
synopsis: Over one long, hot summer in Kanpur, three small-time hustlers find their lives colliding in increasingly absurd ways. Lallan is a leather-goods dealer who owes money to a dangerous moneylender. Pinky is a wedding planner with a talent for forging documents. And Chhote is a nervous college student who has been mistaken for a hired hitman. When a suitcase full of cash goes missing during a lavish wedding, all three become suspects, chased by a gangster, a crooked policeman and the bride's furious father. Told in interconnected chapters with shifting points of view, the film is a crime comedy full of local slang, sharp dialogue and a parade of eccentric characters, from a philosophical paan seller to a cricket-obsessed bodyguard. Fast-paced and sly, it captures the energy, humour and chaos of a north Indian city where everyone has a scheme and nobody can keep a secret for long.

title: Mangal Pe Mehman
synopsis: In 2041, the first Indian research base on Mars is preparing for its most important event yet: a visit by the country's science minister and a live broadcast to a billion people back home. The base commander, Captain Aarav Joshi, is a perfectionist who has planned every minute. Then a cargo shuttle arrives with an unexpected passenger: his sixty-eight-year-old mother, Kamla, who won a lottery for a civilian seat and has come to see where her son lives. Kamla promptly takes over the base kitchen, rearranges the living quarters, adopts a malfunctioning robot and befriends the whole crew, while Aarav tries desperately to keep her out of the broadcast. When a dust storm cuts communication with Earth and the base faces a real emergency, Kamla's resourcefulness may be exactly what everyone needs. Colourful, warm and full of gentle comedy, the film is a family science-fiction adventure about mothers, sons and finding home in the most unexpected places.

title: Sarihaddu Sainikudu
synopsis: Lance Naik Ravi is a young soldier from a village near Khammam, posted to a remote outpost on the Line of Control in Kashmir. His mother writes every week asking when he will come home for his sister's wedding. When a group of infiltrators attacks the outpost during heavy snowfall, Ravi and a handful of soldiers are cut off from their battalion and must hold their position for two days against a much larger force. Among them are a battle-hardened havildar from Punjab, a nervous signalman from Assam and a young officer on his very first posting. As ammunition runs low and the cold becomes as dangerous as the enemy, the soldiers lean on each other and on memories of home. Back in the village, the family prepares for the wedding without knowing what is happening. Gripping and emotional, the film is a war drama that celebrates courage and sacrifice while honouring the families who wait at home.

title: Kuchipudi Kalyani
synopsis: Kalyani grew up in Kuchipudi, the village that gave the classical dance form its name, learning from her grandfather, a revered guru. When he dies, the family's dance school is left in debt, and Kalyani, now twenty-two, decides to save it by competing in a televised dance reality show in Hyderabad. In the city she is dismissed as old-fashioned by the producers and paired with Sameer, a flashy hip-hop dancer from the city's streets who considers classical dance boring. Their clashes turn into a creative partnership as they begin to combine their styles, and their performances become a sensation. But the producers push for drama and controversy, and the elders back in Kuchipudi accuse Kalyani of corrupting tradition. As the finale approaches, she must decide how far she will go to save her grandfather's legacy. Filled with dazzling dance sequences and music, the film is a vibrant drama about tradition, innovation and finding one's own rhythm.

title: Outer Ring Road
synopsis: Late one night on Hyderabad's Outer Ring Road, cab driver Ramesh picks up a nervous young woman who insists on being driven to the airport immediately. Halfway there, she reveals that she has witnessed a murder at a pharmaceutical company and that the killers are following them. Ramesh, a former police constable dismissed for refusing to take a bribe, has no desire to get involved, but when a car starts chasing them and his cab is shot at, he has no choice. Over one long night, Ramesh and his passenger race along highways, through gated communities and industrial estates, trying to reach the one honest officer Ramesh still trusts. Meanwhile the killers, led by a ruthless security consultant, close in with help from corrupt policemen. Lean and propulsive, the film is a near real-time thriller that turns the city's ring road into a tense battleground, with a hero forced to rediscover his own courage.

title: Pedda Illu Chinna Gola
synopsis: Every Sankranti, all eighteen members of the Pothuri family gather at their grandfather's big house in a village near Eluru. This year the patriarch announces that he has quietly remarried, to a cheerful widow from the next village, and that she will be joining them for the festival. Chaos erupts. His sons worry about the property, his daughters-in-law compete for her favour, the grandchildren find her hilarious and the village gossips cannot stop talking. As the festival unfolds with kite-flying contests, rangoli competitions, decorated bulls and long feasts, the new grandmother turns out to be wiser and kinder than anyone expected, and slowly mends long-running family feuds. Meanwhile, a young cousin falls for the new bride's nephew. Packed with festive colour, music and comic misunderstandings, the film is a warm family entertainer about acceptance, second chances and the joys and frustrations of very large families.

title: Chukki Chandrama
synopsis: Chandru is a quiet telescope maker in a small town near Chitradurga who spends his nights watching the stars from the hill behind his house. Chukki is a lively radio presenter from Bengaluru who arrives in town to record a programme about rural astronomy clubs. They meet on a cold night when she gets lost on the hill, and Chandru shows her the rings of Saturn through one of his handmade telescopes. Over the following weeks, as she records her show, they discover a shared love of the night sky, old film songs and long walks. But Chukki is engaged to a successful businessman in the city, and Chandru is hiding a progressive eye condition that will eventually take away his ability to see the stars. Tender and bittersweet, the film is a romantic drama about seeing and being seen, set against the wide skies, ancient forts and boulder-strewn hills of the Chitradurga region.

title: Railway Colony Rowdy
synopsis: In the sprawling railway colony of Hubballi, Mahesh is the son of a respected loco pilot and the leader of a gang of unemployed young men who spend their days playing cricket and getting into fights. When a powerful scrap-metal mafia begins stealing railway property and intimidating residents into selling their homes, Mahesh's father is framed for an accident he did not cause. Determined to clear his father's name, Mahesh takes on the mafia, using his knowledge of the colony's yards, sheds and rail lines. He is helped by Pooja, a railway police officer who shares his suspicions, and by his gang, who are finally given something worth fighting for. The battle escalates from street fights to chases across moving trains and a showdown in an abandoned locomotive shed. Full of crowd-pleasing moments and lively music, the film is an action drama about family honour, community and the people who keep the railways running.

title: Ajji Mane Aircon
synopsis: During a scorching summer in Raichur, eighty-year-old Ajji, who has never owned anything electrical except a radio, decides she wants an air conditioner. Her sons in Bengaluru are baffled but agree to send the money. What follows is a chaotic comedy of errors involving an incompetent salesman, a crooked electrician, a sagging power line and a neighbour convinced that the machine will bring bad luck. Ajji's grandson Kishore, a lazy college student sent to supervise, ends up spending the summer with her and slowly learns about her life, her sharp humour and the husband she lost decades ago. Meanwhile, the air conditioner becomes the centre of the neighbourhood, drawing visitors, gossip and a romance between the electrician and the local schoolteacher. Light, sunny and full of north Karnataka flavour, the film is a family comedy about generations, small pleasures and the cool relief that comes from real connection.

title: Mulugida Charchu
synopsis: Every summer, when the waters of a reservoir near Hassan recede, the ruins of an old church rise from the lake, and tourists come to photograph them. This year the falling water reveals something else: a skeleton in the church's flooded bell tower. Inspector Shalini, newly posted to the area, begins investigating and learns that the remains belong to a young woman who disappeared from a nearby village forty years earlier, just before the dam was completed and the village was submerged. Her inquiry takes her into the memories of displaced villagers, a retired engineer who worked on the dam and a powerful family that profited from the land deals. As the water begins to rise again with the coming monsoon, Shalini races to uncover the truth before the evidence and the church vanish beneath the lake once more. Haunting and atmospheric, the film is a mystery thriller about displacement, memory and crimes that a community chose to bury.

title: Neon Rain in Taipei
synopsis: Former Hong Kong police officer Daniel Leung now works as a freelance investigator in Taipei, taking the cases nobody else wants. When a British tech executive hires him to find her missing teenage daughter, last seen at a night market, Daniel follows a trail into the city's underworld of gambling dens, hacker collectives and organised crime. He is joined by Mei, a sharp-tongued local journalist investigating a string of disappearances that the police seem determined to ignore. The deeper they dig, the clearer it becomes that the girl's disappearance is tied to a data-trafficking operation run by powerful people with long reach. Every ally may be an informant, and Daniel's own past in Hong Kong comes back to haunt him. Shot in rain-soaked neon streets with bruising fight sequences, the film is a stylish crime thriller that blends noir atmosphere with fast-paced action and a weary hero who cannot leave a missing child unfound.

title: Snowbound at Aldergate Inn
